llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is exactly one intramolecular 5-endo-dig benzofuran construction. The precursor contains the complete tether: its phenolic O (atom 20), alkyne carbon attached to the nitrile-aryl ring (atom 8), the second alkyne carbon, and the two adjacent fused aryl atoms. Only the O19-C7 closure is newly formed; pi-bond reorganization and transfer of the phenolic proton to C3 rearomatize the five-membered benzofuran. The pendant nitrile-aryl to C2 connection is preserved, the phenolic O remains bound to the same fused aryl carbon, and the CF3 position remains fixed on that fused ring. Carbonate is a non-product base; the reported K/C/O deficit is its expected unmodeled salt/byproduct inventory, not missing product atoms. The high-risk gate correctly detects a new fused ring but does not identify a chemical contradiction. Its proof obligations are satisfied by explicit tether, atom-source, changed-bond, anchor, and regioselectivity evidence. The saturated-chain smart-cap action is rejected because it destroys the required alkyne-derived benzofuran topology. This supports route-plan revision 2.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one Pd/Cu Sonogashira C(sp)-C(sp2) coupling. Oxidative addition occurs only at the bromo substituent of 2-fluoro-4-bromobenzonitrile; copper acetylide transfer and reductive elimination connect that aryl carbon to the terminal carbon of the CF3-anisole alkyne. The aryl nitrile and aryl fluoride remain permanent handles; Br leaves as bromide and the terminal alkyne H is removed by base, with no product heavy atom unsourced. The methyl ether suppresses phenoxide-mediated cyclization at this coupling stage and is explicitly removed later by the committed BBr3 step. There is one C-Br site and no stereocenter. The sandbox is atom-balanced and has no contradiction; its failure to regenerate the exact alkyne bond is a template coverage limit, outweighed by exact precursor topology and standard Sonogashira mechanism. The original-polarity Sonogashira was rejected because it requires the nitrile-bearing terminal alkyne, while this reverse polarity uses the more activated, single-site electron-poor aryl bromide. Negishi/Kumada alternatives were rejected because an acetylide Zn/Mg reagent increases incompatibility risk with the nitrile without improving convergence. This supports route-plan revision 3.

reactions.label: Sonogashira Coupling

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one Sonogashira coupling between the sole aryl bromide of the CF3-anisole fragment and trimethylsilylacetylene. Negishi/Kumada and directed ortho metalation are rejected because they use less stable organometallic acetylide/aryl anion partners with no selectivity or convergence advantage. This supports route-plan revision 3.

reactions.label: Regioselective electrophilic bromination of 4-(trifluoromethyl)anisole

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one Br2 electrophilic aromatic substitution. Br2 supplies the installed bromine and the complementary bromide forms HBr with the displaced aromatic proton. Strict site fidelity maps exactly one newly brominated site, while the methoxy and para-CF3 anchors are preserved. Because para-CF3 blocks the OMe para site and the two OMe-ortho sites are symmetry-equivalent, controlled monobromination gives the required single 2-bromo-4-CF3 anisole constitutional isomer; assay by LC/MS and 1H/19F NMR is the practical check for dibromination. No C-F, C-O, or CF3 bond is changed. The sandbox is atom-balanced and the absence of a forward template is only a tool limitation. This supports the planned late aryl-bromide installation before Sonogashira.

reactions.label: Williamson O-methylation of 4-(trifluoromethyl)phenol

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This commit is one Williamson O-methylation, not an aryl ether coupling. Carbonate converts 4-(trifluoromethyl)phenol to phenoxide, which reacts by SN2 with MeI; the phenolic oxygen is retained and MeI is the source of the added methoxy carbon. The mapped site audit identifies exactly one O-to-O-Me substituent change, retains the arene scaffold and the para CF3 substituent, and there is no stereochemical or chemoselectivity issue. CF3 is inert under these mild basic methylation conditions. The reported forward-template absence is a coverage limit, while unmodeled carbonate/iodide byproducts do not remove the explicit source of every product atom. This supports the active plan by making the protected small anisole fragment independently from a simple phenol before the committed TMS-alkyne/Sonogashira sequence.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Ullmann arylation would introduce an aryl halide at this O-Me site and does not represent methyl installation.
Chan-Lam arylation wrongly replaces the required methyl donor with an arylboronic acid.
SNAr from an aryl fluoride would construct an aryl ether rather than the observed anisole O-Me bond.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one Sandmeyer cyanation performed through the in situ diazonium intermediate. The parent bromo-fluoroaniline retains the complete arene topology; CuCN supplies the newly installed nitrile C and N, while the aniline nitrogen is deliberately expelled as N2. Practical development must verify Br retention and suppress diazo reduction/hydrolysis, and this step remains medium confidence pending those assays.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: One mechanistically real amidation. Independent indexed structures identify acid_branch atom 13 as the CO2H carbonyl carbon (bonded to O14, O15 and thienylglycine alpha-C12) and amine_branch atom 5 as the free alpha-amino N (bonded only to alpha-C4). In the product the corresponding central bond is product atom 14 carbonyl C to product atom 13 homophenylalanine N. Acid alpha-C12 remains bonded to amide N11, carbonyl C13 and thiophene C16; amine alpha-C4 remains bonded to terminal methylamide C2, amino N5 and side-chain C6. Thus only the intended C(acyl)-N bond is formed; ring substitution patterns, both alpha skeletons and stereocenters are preserved. The acid precursor supplies the complete dimethoxybenzyl-glycinyl-thienylglycine segment and acyl C/O, the amine supplies N and the entire homophenylalanine methylamide, and EDCI/DIPEA supply no target atoms. Cold short activation and rapid workup limit oxazolone epimerization; require chiral verification. The forward-template absence is only a tool limit.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: Convergent two-branch synthesis of CLEO4-88. Disconnect the central homophenylalanine amide late. Build the acid branch by coupling Boc-N-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl)glycine acid with methyl (S)-2-thienylglycinate, then selectively hydrolyze that methyl ester and rem
key_disconnections: Central amide: acid branch plus (S)-homophenylalanine methylamide.
Thienylglycine amide: Boc-N-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl)glycine acid plus methyl (S)-2-thienylglycinate.
Benzyl C-N bond: N-Boc glycine methyl ester plus 3,4-dimethoxybenzyl bromide.
Thienylglycine C-alpha/C2-thiophene bond: R-sulfinyl iminoacetate plus thiophene-2-boronic acid.
preferred_precursor_logic: Use HATU/DIPEA or EDCI/Oxyma-type peptide coupling at low temperature with preactivation minimized.
Use cold dilute LiOH in THF/MeOH/water for methyl ester hydrolysis and monitor to completion.
Use near-anhydrous 4 M HCl/dioxane or HCl/EtOAc for direct sulfinyl removal and isolate amino ester hydrochloride.
protect_or_preserve: Preserve target aryl/heteroaryl topology throughout.
Preserve both alpha-S centers; no alpha C-N or C-C bond is broken after installation.
Retain methyl ester during N-sulfinyl cleavage.
mode_evidence: The target site map exposes the central amide as a convergent late disconnection while mature aryl and heteroaryl scaffolds can be preserved
Both target stereocenters map directly to chiral or stereocontrolled branch precursors.
The exact methyl amino ester required downstream is obtained directly from the isolated N-sulfinyl methyl ester.
strategic_risks: Epimerization at either alpha stereocenter during coupling or hydrolysis.
Boc-selective ester hydrolysis requires controlled LiOH exposure.
Rh addition conversion and dr require empirical optimization and independent stereochemical assignment.
N-S cleavage must avoid ester hydrolysis and preserve C-alpha configuration.
revision_triggers: Failure of direct HCl cleavage to retain CO2Me and alpha-S configuration.
Failure to isolate the required Rh addition diastereomer.
Evidence that either peptide coupling racemizes appreciably.
Failure of mild LiOH hydrolysis to retain Boc.

reaction_context.reaction_type: EDCI-mediated amide coupling of acid branch with (S)-homophenylalanine methylamide

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One real amidation event. EDCI activates the thienylglycine carboxyl group of the acid branch; the alpha-amino nitrogen of the (S)-homophenylalanine methylamide attacks and water-equivalent is lost. The acid branch supplies the complete dimethoxybenzyl-glycinyl-(S)-2-thienylglycine skeleton and the amide carbonyl; the amine branch supplies the NH, (S)-homophenylalanine skeleton and terminal N-methylamide. The only new product bond is acid carbonyl C to homophenylalanine alpha-N. Both alpha C-C/C-N frameworks, both aromatic rings, thiophene, methoxy groups and terminal methylamide are retained. Cold short preactivation, nonnucleophilic base and rapid workup limit oxazolone formation and epimerization.

reactions.rationale: One mechanistically real amidation. Independent indexed structures identify acid_branch atom 13 as the CO2H carbonyl carbon (bonded to O14, O15 and thienylglycine alpha-C12) and amine_branch atom 5 as the free alpha-amino N (bonded only to alpha-C4). In the product the corresponding central bond is product atom 14 carbonyl C to product atom 13 homophenylalanine N. Acid alpha-C12 remains bonded to amide N11, carbonyl C13 and thiophene C16; amine alpha-C4 remains bonded to terminal methylamide C2, amino N5 and side-chain C6. Thus only the intended C(acyl)-N bond is formed; ring substitution patterns, both alpha skeletons and stereocenters are preserved. The acid precursor supplies the complete dimethoxybenzyl-glycinyl-thienylglycine segment and acyl C/O, the amine supplies N and the entire homophenylalanine methylamide, and EDCI/DIPEA supply no target atoms. Cold short activation and rapid workup limit oxazolone epimerization; require chiral verification. The forward-template absence is only a tool limit.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: One real acid-promoted Boc cleavage. HCl protonates the carbamate, tert-butyl cleavage followed by decarboxylation exposes the secondary amine; the isolated material may be its HCl salt although the tree uses the neutral form. Every product heavy atom maps to the precursor. Only the N-Boc substituent is removed as the C5O2-derived CO2/isobutene or tert-butanol byproducts. The N-benzyl and N-glycinyl C-N bonds, peptide amide, thienylglycine CO2H, thiophene C2 topology and alpha-S configuration remain. Cold short HCl/dioxane or HCl/EtOAc avoids anisyl ether cleavage and unnecessary acid residence. Rachel maps 100% of product atoms and identifies exactly one protecting-group site change; no contradiction or proof obligation exists.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: Convergent two-branch synthesis of CLEO4-88. Disconnect the central homophenylalanine amide late. Build the acid branch by coupling Boc-N-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl)glycine acid with methyl (S)-2-thienylglycinate, then selectively hydrolyze that methyl ester and rem
key_disconnections: Central amide: acid branch plus (S)-homophenylalanine methylamide.
Thienylglycine amide: Boc-N-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl)glycine acid plus methyl (S)-2-thienylglycinate.
Benzyl C-N bond: N-Boc glycine methyl ester plus 3,4-dimethoxybenzyl bromide.
Thienylglycine C-alpha/C2-thiophene bond: R-sulfinyl iminoacetate plus thiophene-2-boronic acid.
preferred_precursor_logic: Use HATU/DIPEA or EDCI/Oxyma-type peptide coupling at low temperature with preactivation minimized.
Use cold dilute LiOH in THF/MeOH/water for methyl ester hydrolysis and monitor to completion.
Use near-anhydrous 4 M HCl/dioxane or HCl/EtOAc for direct sulfinyl removal and isolate amino ester hydrochloride.
protect_or_preserve: Preserve target aryl/heteroaryl topology throughout.
Preserve both alpha-S centers; no alpha C-N or C-C bond is broken after installation.
Retain methyl ester during N-sulfinyl cleavage.
mode_evidence: The target site map exposes the central amide as a convergent late disconnection while mature aryl and heteroaryl scaffolds can be preserved
Both target stereocenters map directly to chiral or stereocontrolled branch precursors.
The exact methyl amino ester required downstream is obtained directly from the isolated N-sulfinyl methyl ester.
strategic_risks: Epimerization at either alpha stereocenter during coupling or hydrolysis.
Boc-selective ester hydrolysis requires controlled LiOH exposure.
Rh addition conversion and dr require empirical optimization and independent stereochemical assignment.
N-S cleavage must avoid ester hydrolysis and preserve C-alpha configuration.
revision_triggers: Failure of direct HCl cleavage to retain CO2Me and alpha-S configuration.
Failure to isolate the required Rh addition diastereomer.
Evidence that either peptide coupling racemizes appreciably.
Failure of mild LiOH hydrolysis to retain Boc.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: One ester saponification at the thienylglycine CO2Me carbonyl. Hydroxide addition and methoxide expulsion followed by cold acidic workup gives CO2H; the precursor supplies all product carbon and the carbonyl O, while water/hydroxide supplies the hydroxy O/H and methanol is discarded. Full product atom coverage and the strict site audit identify only the intended CO2Me-to-CO2H change; the N-Boc carbamate, internal amide, N-benzyl bond, dimethoxyaryl topology, C-alpha-thiophene bond and alpha-S framework are preserved. Use dilute 1.0-1.1 equiv LiOH at 0-5 C, monitor and quench immediately. This kinetic exposure is compatible with the slower Boc/amide hydrolyses but their retention must be verified by LC-MS/NMR; verify ee by chiral analysis. No contradiction or proof obligation is present.

selected_attempt.reaction_type: Cold controlled LiOH hydrolysis of thienylglycine methyl ester

reaction_context.reaction_type: Cold controlled LiOH hydrolysis of thienylglycine methyl ester

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One real ester saponification. Hydroxide adds to the thienylglycine methyl ester carbonyl, tetrahedral collapse ejects methoxide, and acidic workup gives CO2H. The precursor supplies the entire carbon skeleton and carbonyl oxygen; water/hydroxide supplies the hydroxy oxygen/proton and methanol is the leaving byproduct. Only CO2Me becomes CO2H. The N-Boc dimethoxybenzylglycinyl unit, internal amide, thiophene C2-alpha-C bond and alpha-S configuration are retained. Use 1.0-1.1 equiv LiOH in dilute THF/MeOH/water at 0-5 C, monitor closely, stop immediately at completion and acidify cold. These kinetic conditions are materially milder than concentrated prolonged strong base; Boc carbamate and amide hydrolysis are slower, and the alpha stereocenter is not intentionally enolized. Confirm Boc retention by LC-MS/NMR and ee by chiral analysis.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One real ester saponification. Hydroxide adds to the thienylglycine methyl ester carbonyl, tetrahedral collapse ejects methoxide, and acidic workup gives CO2H. The N-Boc dimethoxybenzylglycinyl unit, internal amide, thiophene C2-alpha-C bond and alpha-S configuration are retained. Use 1.0-1.1 equiv LiOH in dilute THF/MeOH/water at 0-5 C, monitor closely, stop immediately at completion and acidify cold. Confirm Boc retention by LC-MS/NMR and ee by chiral analysis.

reactions.label: Amide Coupling EDC HATU

template_evidence.template_name: Amide Coupling EDC HATU (Retro, ester amide)

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one real peptide-style amide-forming event: HATU activates the carboxyl group of 4-chloro-3-(fluorosulfonyl)benzoic acid, then the sole exocyclic para-aniline on the advanced core attacks C13 and collapses to form N12-C13. Site fidelity is exact: the selected non-ring amide bond is atoms 12-13; no fused-core bond, aromatic triazole N, imine, tert-butyl ester, aryl chloride, or aryl-SO2F bond is rewritten. Atom accounting is complete: N12 and the chiral triazolothienodiazepine/tert-butyl ester scaffold come from the core aniline; C13/O14, the chlorophenyl ring, S/O/O/F, and Cl come from the benzoic acid. The carboxyl OH oxygen is expelled through the activated-ester manifold, and HATU plus DIPEA are non-incorporated activation/base reagents. Conducting the coupling dry at 0 C then only briefly at ambient temperature with a hindered tertiary base limits SO2F hydrolysis or substitution; the carboxyl-derived activated ester is kinetically preferred over the less reactive aryl sulfonyl fluoride. The core contains no competing free aliphatic amine, the triazole nitrogens are aromatic/deactivated, and no stereogenic bond is made or broken, so atom-29 S configuration is preserved. The sandbox graph reports fragment merge and clear gate; its partial MCS map and target-not-regenerated template observation do not contradict the exact precursor-to-product atom assignment. The acid-chloride competitor is rejected because generating and carrying O=C(Cl)c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)F)c(Cl)c1 creates two highly electrophilic sulfur/acyl fluoride-sensitive handles and offers no route-quality gain over in-situ mild activation.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Acid chloride amidation is chemically plausible but is less conservative for concurrent aryl sulfonyl fluoride retention; it adds a reactive acyl chloride preparation/handling burden without improving convergence or site fidelity.

Rachel strict site-fidelity mapping independently reports only the sulfonyl substituent changed at the same aryl carbon, with both the carboxyl-bearing and aryl-chloride-bearing anchors preserved. llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one chemoselective nitro-to-aniline reduction. The para-nitro advanced core is treated with Fe/NH4Cl in ethanol/water or a comparably non-hydrogenating nitro-reduction system; sequential electron/proton transfer through nitroso and hydroxylamine intermediates retains the aryl carbon-nitrogen bond and furnishes the para-NH2 group. Rachel maps 100% of the product skeleton and identifies only nitro_to_amine; its O=2 balance warning is the expected unmodeled small-molecule water, while the forward template returns protonated aniline and therefore is a protonation-state/tool limitation rather than a topology contradiction. The fused thiophene-triazole-diazepine scaffold, imine, tert-butyl ester, and every bond at the S stereocenter are untouched. Avoid Pd/C/H2 because the fused imine is a plausible competing hydrogenation site; neutral metal reduction minimizes that risk and avoids the heat/base combination that could promote the reported ester/amine aminolysis. Confirm loss of the nitro signal and retention of the imine/ester by LC-MS and NMR before final HATU coupling. This supports the recorded late-aniline and late-convergence strategy.

reactions.label: Aryldiazonium Sandmeyer-Meyer chlorosulfonylation

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one defined Sandmeyer-Meyer radical chlorosulfonylation event, executed after the diazonium salt has been generated separately. Cu(I) transfers one electron to the aryl diazonium cation, the two diazonium nitrogens leave as N2, and the aryl radical is trapped by SO2. Chloride transfer to the resulting arylsulfonyl radical furnishes the S(O)2Cl group. The sulfur and both product sulfonyl oxygens are supplied by SO2; the sulfonyl chloride chlorine is supplied by the declared chloride/CuCl manifold. The carboxyl group and the pre-existing aryl chloride are retained exactly. Rachel strict site-fidelity maps only the intended aryl substituent change from diazonium to S(O)2Cl and preserves the carboxyl and aryl-chloride anchors; partial MCS coverage is expected because N2 is lost and SO2 is incorporated. The Cl=1/Cu=1/N=2 unmodeled remainder corresponds to chloride/copper speciation and gaseous N2, not a product atom deficit. The no-forward-template result is a coverage limit only. Operationally, generate the diazonium salt cold, consume it immediately under SO2 with Cu(I), exclude excess water, and monitor for desulfonylation, aryl-radical dimerization, hydrolysis to sulfonic acid, and loss of the retained aryl chloride. This is deliberately recorded as the first, independently auditable event of the active two-step strategy; it supports rather than replaces the separate diazotization event.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one intramolecular ketoamine-to-imine cyclodehydration, with the topology proof supplied before commit. reactions.label: Cold aryl amine diazotization

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one cold diazotization event. In 0-5 C mineral acid, nitrite generates the nitrosating species; the aryl-bound amino nitrogen remains bonded to the aryl carbon and becomes the proximal diazonium nitrogen, while the nitrite nitrogen becomes the terminal diazonium nitrogen. Dehydration removes oxygen/protons as water. Thus both diazonium nitrogens have explicit sources, while Na and the residual nitrite oxygen in the sandbox warning belong to expected sodium/inorganic and water byproducts. Strict site mapping shows only the selected aryl substituent changes from NH2 to N2+ and preserves both the carboxyl and aryl-chloride anchors. The primary-amine compatibility warning describes the intended diazotization chemistry, not an unintended competing site. No ring, C-C, carboxyl, or aryl-Cl bond is altered. The formal chloride counterion was split as a separate salt leaf by Rachel and is deliberately not treated as a scaffold fragment. Forward-template absence is the sole inconclusive cause, with no contradictions or evidence gaps. Keep the diazonium cold and immediately consume it under SO2/CuCl to suppress hydrolysis, phenol formation, dediazoniation, or diazo coupling. This completes the declared second real event of the aryl-sulfonyl chloride strategy.

reactions.rationale: This is a single imidate-to-amidrazone formation, not a compressed sequence. In the forward direction, terminal nitrogen of ArNHNH2 adds to the carbon of ethyl acetimidate hydrochloride, proton transfer and loss of ethanol furnish CC(N)=NNAr; triethylamine releases the free imidate/hydrazine pair and captures HCl. The ethyl acetimidate supplies the methyl, amidine carbon, and exocyclic NH2 nitrogen; the arylhydrazine supplies the two joined N atoms attached to the thiophene. Ethanol and triethylammonium chloride are omitted small-molecule/byproduct streams. The apparent reagent-only atom remainder is therefore a representation consequence of including recoverable triethylamine, while every product atom has a defined precursor source. Strict site mapping retained the full nitrobenzoyl thiophene and its regioisomer, changing only the hydrazine substituent into the acetimidrazone; no C-C, S-C, or ring topology changes occur. Neutral ethanol/controlled cold addition is compatible with the aryl nitro group and benzoyl ketone, and avoids conditions that would affect either. reactions.label: Lewis-acid Friedel-Crafts nitrobenzoylation of 2,5-dimethylthiophene

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one Lewis-acid Friedel-Crafts acylation, not a scaffold rearrangement. SnCl4 activates the 4-nitrobenzoyl chloride; a beta carbon of 2,5-dimethylthiophene traps the acylium equivalent and rearomatizes. The two beta C-H sites are symmetry-equivalent in the dimethylthiophene precursor, so the observed product has no unresolved constitutional regioisomer. All aroyl atoms, including the carbonyl C/O and para-nitro substituent, come from the acid chloride; its Cl and the displaced thiophene H make HCl. Both methyl groups and the thiophene sulfur are retained, and no stereocenter is present. One-equivalent, low-temperature addition is the control for overacylation, while the installed electron-withdrawing aroyl group deactivates the remaining beta site. Nitro is retained under the controlled Lewis-acid conditions. The template coverage limit is not chemical contrary evidence. This completes the planned two-step rollback to simple stable building blocks and supports the global core-assembly thesis.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One Lewis-acid-promoted Friedel-Crafts acylation event: SnCl4 activates 4-nitrobenzoyl chloride, and one beta carbon of symmetric 2,5-dimethylthiophene captures the acylium equivalent to form the thiophene-C(=O)-aryl bond. The carbonyl carbon, carbonyl oxygen, nitrophenyl ring, nitro N/O atoms, and chlorine leaving group source are all defined by the acid chloride; the thiophene beta carbon and its lost H originate from dimethylthiophene. Its two beta C-H positions are symmetry-equivalent before reaction, so no constitutional regioisomer choice is introduced. Low-temperature addition with one equivalent of acyl chloride limits competing polyacylation; the newly installed electron-withdrawing aroyl group then deactivates the remaining beta site. The nitro group is retained and is compatible with Lewis-acid acylation under controlled temperature. This is continuation step 1 of sketch:mol_19:0 and creates the aryl ketone anchor without ring construction or stereochemical change.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the alpha-aminonitrile phosphonate CCOP(=O)(OCC)C(C#N)NC(=O)OC(C)(C)C is deprotonated and undergoes HWE olefination with 4-methoxybenzaldehyde COc1ccc(C=O)cc1. The phosphonate supplies the nitrile-bearing alkene carbon and N-Boc carbamate; the aldehyde supplies the second alkene carbon and para-anisyl ring. The E-alkene product COc1ccc(C=CC(C#N)NC(=O)OC(C)(C)C)cc1 is the exact current node. DBU/DMF provides a closed-shell base/solvent representation; the methoxy group avoids phenol competition and is intentionally removed later by BBr3. No ring is built or opened, and every new C/N/O atom is sourced from the two route-bearing precursors.

key_disconnections: Disconnect the amide linking the central alpha-amino acid to the lysine-like chain at the carbonyl/amine interface.
Disconnect the aryl sulfonamide at the aryl-S(VI)-N bond using an arylsulfonyl chloride and a protected aminoalkyl amide

preferred_precursor_logic: Protected amino-acid building blocks for each stereocenter; use benzyl/CBZ/Boc/Fmoc logic with explicit deprotection steps.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用收敛式hybrid路线：保留已成熟的异恶唑-膦酸-芳基骨架，先以卤代异恶唑酸的Miyaura硼化/Suzuki事件建立芳基连接，再将异恶唑乙酸与受保护的多肽样alpha-胺偶联；另一支由受保护alpha-氨基腈膦酸酯与对甲氧基苯甲醛HWE构建烯基腈，随后还原胺化接入戊酸链、形成对位芳基磺酰胺，最后通过正交脱保护得到目标。
key_disconnections: 异恶唑C-Br先逆向为芳基溴酸与硼酸（Miyaura硼化），再与对溴苯乙醚进行Suzuki形成异恶唑-芳基C-C键。
异恶唑-CH2-C(O)NH- alpha-氨基酸键：异恶唑乙酸与受保护alpha-胺进行HATU/EDC酰胺偶联。
alpha-氨基酸羧酸与lysine-like链的alpha-胺断开为氨基酸羧酸和含侧链酰胺/芳基磺酰氯的胺片段。
芳基S(VI)-N键断开为对位芳基磺酰氯和氨基乙腈/受保护氨基戊酸片段。
preferred_precursor_logic: 使用可分离的Boc/Fmoc/Cbz保护alpha-氨基酸和lysine-like片段；每个酰胺只提交一个真实偶联事件。
芳基磺酰氯与氨基乙腈或受保护氨基戊酸衍生物反应，保留腈和烯基电子单元。
用B2pin2/Pd/碱把异恶唑芳基溴转成硼酸或硼酸酯，再做Suzuki；膦酸需要时以酯形式耐受偶联。
protect_or_preserve: 保留异恶唑环、环上COP(=O)(O)Ph和乙酸侧链的相对位置；不进行未经证明的环重建。
alpha-胺用Boc/Fmoc等保护，侧链胺在芳基磺酰化/酰胺偶联时保持正交选择性。
酚先以甲醚存在并在肽段/磺酰胺完成后BBr3脱保护；腈和烯基在还原胺化与偶联中保持。
mode_evidence: 目标含成熟异恶唑和膦酸芳基核心，保留核心比从头重建杂环更可信；已提交的Miyaura硼化和Suzuki候选保持该拓扑。
目标的多个酰胺和一个芳基磺酰胺提供天然收敛断点；已提交的三次酰胺/磺酰胺事件给出可执行的片段来源。
HWE、BBr3脱甲醚和还原胺化把烯基腈/酚/多胺兼容性问题分散到可控的保护状态。
strategic_risks: alpha-氨基酸立体中心必须由明确的手性前体或立体保持条件提供；当前SMILES未编码绝对构型，后续需避免无依据地宣称立体选择性。
游离伯胺、羧酸、酚和磺酰氯并存时有盐形成和误酰化竞争，需保持Boc/其他正交保护并按顺序偶联。
膦酸和多酰胺可能螯合Pd或降低溶解度；Suzuki优先在肽段组装前完成，膦酸必要时以酯保护。
硼化/ Suzuki模板未显式账务小分子，提交时需持续核对B/O/卤素来源。
revision_triggers: 位点或沙盒映射显示异恶唑芳基连接发生拓扑漂移或卤代/硼酸来源无法闭合。
任何肽偶联出现alpha-胺/侧链胺选择性矛盾，或需要未声明的保护基迁移。
关键立体中心无法追溯到手性氨基酸/立体保持步骤。
发现比顺序酰胺组装更可信且已验证的收敛断裂。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: one late functional-group conversion of the already formed para-benzamide arylsulfonic acid into the corresponding arylsulfonyl chloride. Thionyl chloride activates the sulfonic acid and replaces the S-OH bond by S-Cl; chlorine comes from O=S(Cl)Cl, while the aryl ring, benzamide, Boc-protected alpha-amine, side-chain amide, and all peptide stereochemical relationships remain unchanged. This event creates the planned SO2Cl handle only after the carboxylic-acid amidation, avoiding direct amine attack on SO2Cl during that earlier coupling. No new carbon or stereocenter is introduced; only the sulfur(VI) leaving group is edited.

preferred_precursor_logic: 先用SO3H或其可转化盐作为芳基磺酰氯的安全前体，避免SO2Cl与游离胺同时存在。
用Boc保护alpha-胺、暴露侧链胺做羧酸酰胺化；每次偶联只形成一个酰胺键。
氯化用SOCl2/草酰氯等明确氯源，随后再以受保护氨基乙腈完成磺酰胺。
protect_or_preserve: 保留异恶唑、膦酸苯基和芳基-异恶唑相对拓扑；C-Br仅在Suzuki前短程携带。
alpha-胺Boc保护直到侧链苯甲酰化结束；侧链胺是羧酸偶联位点。

reaction_context.reaction_type: Aryl sulfonic acid chlorination to sulfonyl chloride

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: one late functional-group conversion of the already formed para-benzamide arylsulfonic acid into the corresponding arylsulfonyl chloride. Thionyl chloride activates the sulfonic acid and replaces the S-OH bond by S-Cl; chlorine comes from O=S(Cl)Cl, while the aryl ring, benzamide, Boc-protected alpha-amine, side-chain amide, and all peptide stereochemical relationships remain unchanged. This event creates the planned SO2Cl handle only after the carboxylic-acid amidation, avoiding direct amine attack on SO2Cl during that earlier coupling. No new carbon or stereocenter is introduced; only the sulfur(VI) leaving group is edited.

The aldehyde carbon becomes the alpha stereogenic carbon, HCN supplies the nitrile carbon/nitrogen pair, and ammonia supplies the amino nitrogen; water is the condensation byproduct. The phosphonate ester remains intact and no ring/topology edits occur. With achiral inputs this event is racemic at alpha-C; because the target SMILES does not encode @/@@, the route records racemate or a required later resolution rather than claiming asymmetric induction.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用收敛式hybrid路线，但暂停沿用错误的diamino-amide保护基假设：异恶唑-膦酸核心和芳基尾部的SO3H先羧酸偶联、后转SO2Cl的时序保留；对CC(C)(C)OC(=O)NC(=O)C(N)CCCCN必须先纠正Boc连接位点与α/侧链胺选择性，再继续尾部组装。
key_disconnections: 异恶唑C-Br→硼酸（Miyaura）→对溴苯乙醚Suzuki，保留异恶唑拓扑。
异恶唑乙酸与受保护α-胺的HATU/EDC偶联。
中心α-氨基酸羧酸与lysine-like片段α-胺的酰胺断开。
芳基尾部仍采用4-carboxybenzenesulfonic acid先酰胺化、后SO3H→SO2Cl，但只在胺位点与保护基得到独立证据后继续。
preferred_precursor_logic: 先用SO3H或其盐作为芳基磺酰氯前体，避免SO2Cl与游离胺共存。
真正的选择性芳基羧酸偶联需要α-N保护、侧链-NH2暴露且羧酰胺N不被误作α-N保护；优先使用结构明确的NC(=O)C(NBoc)CCCCN或等价正交保护片段。
若从当前错误片段修复，必须逐一提交脱Boc、正交保护/脱保护等真实事件，并重新审查rxn_16位点；不得用Boc迁移或文字解释代替化学步骤。
protect_or_preserve: 保留异恶唑、膦酸苯基和芳基-异恶唑相对拓扑；C-Br仅在Suzuki前短程携带。
在芳基羧酸酰胺形成前，必须保护α-胺而暴露侧链胺；保护基连接原子必须与SMILES结构一致。
SO3H先作为非亲电硫形态存在，SO2Cl只在羧酸酰胺形成后安装。
mode_evidence: 已验证的HWE、还原胺化、肽/酰胺偶联及异恶唑卤代、Miyaura、Suzuki事件支持保留成熟核心和收敛组装。
当前结构审计显示Boc在一级羧酰胺氮，而非α-胺；原先选择性偶联论证因此失效，必须先修正保护基策略或承认该树边的位点证据不足。
SO3H先偶联、后SOCl2氯化仍能把羧酸与磺酰氯反应中心时序分离。
strategic_risks: 当前已提交的rxn_16把芳基羧酸连接到侧链胺，但其前体α-胺未保护，存在显著竞争/位点错误风险。
直接在双游离胺片段上重做选择性保护可能需要额外正交保护事件，不能压缩成一句解释。
SO3H强酸、后续SO2Cl和多胺/多酰胺条件兼容性需逐步验证。
未编码绝对构型的α-中心只能声明构型保持或由手性原料提供。
revision_triggers: 无法通过明确的保护/脱保护顺序得到真正α-N-Boc、侧链-NH2的可追溯前体。
rxn_16的芳基羧酸酰胺位点无法由原子映射和化学选择性共同支持。
SO3H→SO2Cl或后续磺酰化出现S/Cl/N来源、拓扑或兼容性矛盾。
发现更强且可验证的直接chlorosulfonyl-benzoic acid选择性路线。

template_evidence.template_name: Pri Alcohol To Acid (Retro, oxidation reduction)

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: CHCA mol_20 的第一步回溯采用一个真实的一级醇氧化事件：前体 O=P(O)(OCc1oncc1CCO)c1ccccc1 在 TEMPO/NaClO2（或等效温和双氧化体系）下把异恶唑取代基末端的 –CH2OH 氧化为 –CO2H，得到 O=C(O)Cc1cnoc1COP(=O)(O)c1ccccc1。机制是醇→醛→水合/再氧化至酸；新增的羧酸氧来自氯酸盐/氧化剂与水，碳骨架不新增也不丢失。位点是侧链末端一级醇，不涉及异恶唑环或 benzylic C–O–P 键；异恶唑 N–O、芳基膦酸单酯和环上相对取代位置均保留。采用中性至弱酸、低温的NaClO2/TEMPO类条件并避免强酸/强碱，可降低膦酸酯水解、异恶唑开环和过氧化风险；需要控制氧化剂当量并监测醇→酸完全转化。该步没有新立体中心或立体化学变化，验证的O=1 excess是副产物/氧化剂未显式建模的账务警告，不是骨架矛盾。该事件支持CHCA路线对成熟异恶唑-膦酸核心的保留与晚期官能团编辑。

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: CHCA mol_26 的环回溯采用经典的1,3-二羰基与羟胺成异恶唑的单一环构建事件：O=C(CCO)CC(=O)COP(=O)(O)c1ccccc1 与羟胺（NO；实际可由NH2OH·HCl/碱提供）在乙醇/乙酸钠或类似温和缩合条件下先形成肟，再脱水/环化/芳构化，得到 O=P(O)(OCc1oncc1CCO)c1ccccc1。原子来源明确：二羰基的两个羰基碳和中央亚甲基构成异恶唑的三个碳；二羰基左端的–CH2CH2OH保留为环上相应侧链，右端的–CH2O–P(=O)(OH)Ph保留为另一侧链；羟胺N和O构成相邻的N–O环键。结构审计显示产品保留五元芳香异恶唑（O/N/3C）、苯基膦酸单酯和两个侧链，新增环连接只发生在预定J12位点，环数由1增至2且无融合/桥连/螺环。两个保留锚点是 P–O–CH2–异恶唑侧链和 –CH2CH2OH 侧链；它们在成环后相对位置不移动。官能团兼容性来自中性至弱酸条件：膦酸单酯、末端一级醇和苯基不需要强还原/氧化；需避免过量强酸以降低P–O水解和异恶唑开环。主要选择性风险是非对称1,3-二羰基可能生成区域异构体；电子较贫乏、带–CH2O–P(=O)(OH)Ph的一端预期更易被羟胺初始进攻，采用受控温度/当量并分离目标异构体，不能把模板clear当作无条件区域选择性证明。无新立体中心，故立体化学保持不变。

任何支线步骤需要压缩多步或引入未说明的碳/氮/磷来源。

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: CHCA mol_27 的右侧酮通过经典Fukuyama偶联逆合成：β-酮硫代酯 CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO 与当前步有机锌试剂 O=P(O)(O[CH2][Zn][Cl])c1ccccc1 在Pd催化下偶联，硫代酯羰基保留为目标右侧酮，CH2O–P(=O)(OH)Ph片段由有机锌碳源直接接入，形成 O=C(CCO)CC(=O)COP(=O)(O)c1ccccc1。该步只改变实际 bond:7（目标第二羰基碳与其α-CH2O–P碳之间的C–C键生成），左侧β-酮与末端一级醇保持；没有环或立体中心变化。C/O/P/Ph原子来源分别由完整硫代酯和有机锌片段给出，脱去的MeS与ZnCl进入副产物，正是沙盒报告的C=1、S=1、Zn=1 deficit，不是骨架矛盾。Rachel的precursor_normalization要求保留当前有机锌试剂；其可能的上游来源是 O=P(O)(OCBr)c1ccccc1 与Zn插入，但不把这两个来源材料替换进当前偶联。硫代酯是Fukuyama所需的酰基供体而非游离硫醚；Pd/配体、低温和稀释条件可降低硫配位/催化剂中毒，需控制硫代酯当量并监测β-酮和一级醇稳定性。该事件比对未保护二醇进行P酯化更具P–O–CH2位点保真，支持mol_27继续向明确有机卤化物/金属来源和可购硫代酯终端拆分。

reactions.label: TBS deprotection (retro protection)

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是CHCA硫代酯微路线的第一个真实事件：受保护的 CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C 在TBAF/THF或缓冲氟源下脱去末端一级醇的TBS，得到 CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO。TBS硅、叔丁基和两个甲基来自前体保护基并以硅氧烷/氟硅烷副产物离去；路线骨架的C6、O3、SMe、β-酮和一级醇碳均保留，没有新增或迁移C/N/P。唯一受影响位点是末端O–Si键，硫代酯和内部酮在无水、低温、短时氟化物条件下可保留；需控制水分和氟当量，避免硫代酯水解/烯醇副反应。验证的forward_template_unavailable属于工具覆盖限制，MCS覆盖1.0且无骨架矛盾；C=6、Si=1 deficit是TBS保护基及其副产物未建模。选择该路线是因为已实际拒绝 formaldehyde aldol（site:bond:7:alt:0）：未保护β-酮硫代酯的中央亚甲基更酸，会与目标甲基酮位点竞争，不能把模板clear等同于区域选择性证明。

rejected_alternatives.reason: chemical site-selectivity rejection: central methylene between thioester and ketone is more acidic than the methyl-ketone site, so formaldehyde hydroxymethylation would not reliably give the required regioisomer.

llm_decision.site_audit_summary: No same-core Murcko-preserving major precursor was detected, so site-retention gate does not apply.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the current low-complexity beta-keto thioester CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO is obtained by one fluoride-mediated TBS deprotection of CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C (TBAF or buffered fluoride in THF). The silicon/tert-butyl/dimethyl group is removed from the sole terminal primary alcohol; the thioester carbonyl, SMe bond, internal ketone, and carbon topology are unchanged. No carbon or heteroatom is added to the route-bearing skeleton; the Si fragment leaves as siloxane/fluorosilane. route_plan_brief.route_thesis: CHCA采用收敛式hybrid主路线，保留异恶唑-膦酸-芳基与肽样核心，并在mol_20终端复核支线中继续回溯异恶唑成环和二羰基来源。对于Fukuyama分支得到的CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO，采用三事件保护-酰化-脱保护微路线：先保护末端一级醇，再用甲基氯硫代甲酸酯对受保护4-羟基-2-丁酮的酮烯醇盐做C-酰化，最后脱TBS得到可购/低复杂度硫代酯构件。
key_disconnections: 主路线异恶唑C-Br→硼酸（Miyaura）→对溴苯乙醚Suzuki。
异恶唑乙酸与受保护α-胺的HATU/EDC偶联。
芳基尾部SO3H先ε-N酰化、后SO2Cl、最后氨基乙腈磺酰化。
mol_20→mol_26：一级醇氧化；mol_26→mol_27：1,3-二羰基/羟胺异恶唑成环。
preferred_precursor_logic: SO3H或其盐作为芳基磺酰氯安全前体，SO2Cl晚装。
羧酰胺N-Boc只保护羧酰胺氮，不能声称α-N-Boc。
保留Fukuyama当前有机锌试剂，并把O=P(O)(OCBr)Ph/Zn作为单独上游来源候选。
protect_or_preserve: 主路线保留异恶唑、膦酸苯基和芳基-异恶唑相对拓扑。
J12支线保留五元异恶唑N-O和两个侧链位置。
硫代酯支线的TBS只装在末端一级醇；β-酮、硫代酯羰基和SMe连接保留，C-酰化发生在酮甲基碳。
mode_evidence: CHCA主路线已有HWE、还原胺化、肽/酰胺偶联、异恶唑卤代/Miyaura/Suzuki和晚期磺酰化的连续证据，成熟异恶唑-膦酸核心在主路线中保留。
mol_20→mol_26→mol_27的一级醇氧化与J12异恶唑成环已通过结构/原子账验证。
mol_27→Fukuyama硫代酯/有机锌偶联明确了P–O–CH2位点；硫代酯支线用保护-酰化-脱保护替代区域选择性不足的甲醛羟甲基化。
strategic_risks: Fukuyama步有机锌需从O=P(O)(OCBr)Ph和Zn另建上游来源；当前反应不能把来源材料替换为有机卤化物。
Pd/硫代酯偶联需避免游离硫醚催化剂中毒，并控制β-酮/膦酸兼容性。
末端醇保护与C-酰化需防止O-酰化、过度硅基化和酮烯醇盐在硫代酯条件下的竞争；TBS脱除不能水解硫代酯或膦酸。
主路线rxn_16的未保护二胺ε-N选择性和Strecker外消旋风险仍保留。
revision_triggers: TBS保护/脱保护的原子来源、位点或兼容性出现矛盾。
受保护4-羟基-2-丁酮的C-酰化不能在酮碳上选择性发生，或出现不可接受的O-酰化。
Fukuyama步的有机锌来源或Pd条件无法闭合。
任何支线步骤需要压缩多步或引入未说明的碳/硫/硅来源。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the reactive coupling reagent O=P(O)(O[CH2][Zn][Cl])c1ccccc1 is generated in one upstream source event from the closed-shell bromomethyl phosphinate O=P(O)(OCBr)c1ccccc1 by zinc insertion into C–Br in dry ether/THF, with chloride supplied by the zinc-halide medium. The organic CH2O–P(=O)(OH)Ph skeleton is inherited from the bromide; Zn inserts at the bromomethyl carbon and Br is exchanged/removed, giving the current organozinc-halide reagent for immediate Fukuyama coupling. This reagent is not isolated or treated as a purchasable terminal: it is formed in situ at low temperature and consumed promptly. The phosphinic P–OH may coordinate/deprotonate zinc, so use controlled stoichiometry or its zinc phosphinate salt and avoid any protic solvent; this is a real compatibility risk to monitor, not hidden protection. The step supplies Zn/Cl explicitly in the reagent ledger and keeps the organozinc in the current ketone-forming step.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: one real P-O bond-forming event is proposed. In phenylphosphonic acid O=P(O)(O)c1ccccc1, one P-OH attacks protonated formaldehyde (C=O) and proton transfer gives the mono-hydroxymethyl ester O=P(O)(OCO)c1ccccc1. The formaldehyde carbon becomes the O-CH2-OH carbon and its oxygen becomes the terminal alcohol oxygen; the second P-OH, P=O, P-phenyl bond, aromatic ring, and phosphorus stereochemical environment are retained. Use one equivalent of aqueous formaldehyde, dilute aqueous alcohol, low temperature, and controlled conversion; the mono product is isolated before bis-hydroxymethylation/oligomerization, with LC/NMR monitoring of the remaining P-OH. This avoids the less defensible formate-ester reduction while supplying every new C/O atom explicitly and supports the upstream source sequence for the CHCA Fukuyama reagent.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: CHCA采用收敛式hybrid主路线，保留异恶唑-膦酸-芳基与肽样核心，并在mol_20终端复核支线中继续回溯异恶唑成环和二羰基来源。对于Fukuyama分支得到的CSC(=O)CC(=O)CCO，采用三事件保护-酰化-脱保护微路线：先保护末端一级醇，再用甲基氯硫代甲酸酯对受保护4-羟基-2-丁酮的酮烯醇盐做C-酰化，最后脱TBS得到可购/低复杂度硫代酯构件。
key_disconnections: 主路线异恶唑C-Br→硼酸（Miyaura）→对溴苯乙醚Suzuki。

protect_or_preserve: 主路线保留异恶唑、膦酸苯基和芳基-异恶唑相对拓扑。
J12支线保留五元异恶唑N-O和两个侧链位置。
硫代酯支线的TBS只装在末端一级醇；β-酮、硫代酯羰基和SMe连接保留，C-酰化发生在酮甲基碳。

reactions.rationale: CHCA该上游节点采用直接羟甲基化而不是形式化的“甲酸酯还原”：苯基膦酸 O=P(O)(O)c1ccccc1 的一个P–OH对甲醛羰基进行亲核加成，经质子转移形成 O=P(O)(OCO)c1ccccc1。甲醛的碳成为 O–CH2–OH 中的CH2，甲醛氧成为末端OH；P=O、苯基、另一P–OH以及芳环拓扑保留，site-retentive审计通过且原子账平衡。反应应使用一当量甲醛、稀释水/醇体系、低温和受控转化，尽量在单羟甲基产物处停止并用LC/NMR监控双羟甲基化/缩聚副反应；该选择性是本步骤的主要风险，不能隐藏。起始膦酸的两个P–OH等价，单取代后P中心成为新手性中心，若无手性诱导/拆分则生成外消旋P构型；目标和后续有机锌试剂均未指定P构型，因此不引入未声明的立体化学承诺。该事件将待处理的羟甲基膦酸酯连接到可获得的低复杂度苯基膦酸和甲醛来源，支持CHCA Fukuyama支线的上游来源闭合。

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 以成熟的L-谷氨酸/L-赖氨酸脲核心为主线，采用混合型收敛路线：先验证谷氨酸α-胺与赖氨酸α-异氰酸酯的非对称脲化，再从赖氨酸ε-胺晚期安装双炔苄基氨基甲酸酯；芳基臂单独通过两次Sonogashira从对溴苄醇衍生物和末端炔片段构建，最后按双炔稳定性选择非氢解脱保护。
key_disconnections: bond:6：L-谷氨酸α-胺 + L-赖氨酸α-异氰酸酯（ε-胺以氨基甲酸酯保护）形成非对称脲。
bond:15：赖氨酸ε-胺 + 4-(双炔苄基)苄基氯甲酸酯形成氨基甲酸酯。
bond:23/bond:27：芳基溴化物与相应末端炔片段的两次Sonogashira，两个新C–C键均由明确的炔基/芳基前体供给。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用Nα保护、羧酸酯化的氨基酸衍生物，在脲化/氨基甲酸酯化后再逐步脱保护；若Rachel动作仅展示游离酸，需在commit理由中说明这是映射等价的化学事件而非忽略选择性。
芳基双炔臂以对溴苄醇或其保护衍生物和苯基乙炔/溴代炔为可购或一到两步可得片段。
protect_or_preserve: 保留两个L-α-立体中心及谷氨酸/赖氨酸碳骨架。
在双炔构建和肽偶联期间保护羧酸和非目标胺；避免催化氢化破坏双炔。
mode_evidence: 目标的两个手性α-氨基酸和脲/氨基甲酸酯连接均有明确局部位点证据（bond:6、bond:15）。
bond:23与bond:27显示双炔可拆为芳基卤化物和末端炔的两次交叉偶联，保留芳环拓扑并把高反应性炔基构建放在侧链组装之前。
strategic_risks: 脲化和ε-氨基甲酸酯化必须区分α-胺、ε-胺以及三个羧酸的竞争反应；实际路线需正交保护或在验证中明确选择性。
双炔对氢化条件敏感，避免以氢解作为唯一末端脱保护。
两个α-手性中心在活化羰基/碱性条件下的消旋风险。
revision_triggers: 脲化或氨基甲酸酯化的原子映射/官能团兼容性出现硬矛盾。
双炔交叉偶联需要不现实的有机金属或与肽片段不兼容。
验证显示先装双炔再脲化比当前顺序更能避免保护基/选择性冲突。

reactions.rationale: 这是一个单一的N-Boc脱保护事件。TFA质子化Boc羰基后触发叔丁基-氧键裂解，随后脱羧并释放L-谷氨酸α-胺；两个羧酸、Cα–Cβ–Cγ骨架和S构型均不变。前体中的Boc碳/氧/叔丁基是离去保护基来源，TFA作为当前步试剂已显式列出；未将TFA或其副产物误当作路线骨架。Rachel的MCS覆盖为1.0且功能团差异明确标记为protecting_group_removed，无独立骨架矛盾。沙盒为inconclusive仅因无该自定义反应的正向模板及副产物未建模，这属于工具覆盖限制而非化学否定；机制、位点和立体化学证据替代该限制。该步把游离L-谷氨酸作为可追溯的采购型手性片段，避免用不可靠的α-卤代氨解伪造更深路线。

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 该步把赖氨酸衍生物的α-胺转成α-异氰酸酯，是一个单一的制备性活化事件：胺先与O=CCl2形成氨基甲酰氯，随后脱HCl得到R-CH(N=C=O)-CO2H。ε-氨基甲酸酯、α-羧酸、四碳侧链和Cα构型均保留；Rachel严格位点审计显示same_core=true、changed_site_count=1，仅α-胺位点由N变为NCO。异氰酸酯新增的碳和氧均来自显式列出的phosgene，氯作为HCl离去，不存在未交代的骨架原子。真实操作会使用羧酸酯保护或缓冲/低温条件避免羧酸被过度活化；当前游离酸是与目标树一致的映射等价表示。沙盒inconclusive只因为没有可执行的正向模板，且无contradictions/proof_obligations；这不是化学否定，独立机制和位点证据足以支持提交。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: positive chemical case: the alpha amine of the lysine derivative reacts with phosgene through a carbamoyl chloride intermediate and base-promoted HCl loss to give the N=C=O group at the same alpha-carbon; the epsilon carbamate, carboxylic acid, carbon skeleton, and stereocenter are retained. In practice, use a protected-carboxylate variant or buffered biphasic conditions to suppress acid activation, but the Rachel graph is the deprotected mapping-equivalent substrate.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是芳基双炔苄醇转为苄基氯甲酸酯的单一活化事件：苄醇氧进攻O=CCl2，随后碱捕获HCl，生成O=C(Cl)OCH2-Ar。芳环、两个炔键和苄基连接拓扑均不变；新增氯甲酸酯羰基碳/氧以及Cl均由显式phosgene提供，三乙胺只承担酸捕获，不进入路线骨架。该高反应性把手被刻意放在双炔构建之后、ε-胺捕获之前。Rachel严格位点审计same_core=true、仅苄氧位点改变；gate inconclusive来自无正向模板和副产物未建模，且将官能团差异标成alcohol_to_halide是表示层标签，不是骨架矛盾。以独立氯甲酸酯机制、完整原子来源和保留双炔证据覆盖工具限制。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: positive chemical case: the benzylic alcohol attacks phosgene and, after base-mediated chloride capture, gives the closed-shell benzyl chloroformate used for selective epsilon-amine carbamoylation. This is one real activation event performed after the bis-alkyne scaffold is assembled, keeping the acid chloride handle late.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是一个单一的Sonogashira交叉偶联：对溴苄醇的芳基C–Br与苯基丁-1,3-二炔的末端C–H在Pd/Cu/碱条件下偶联，形成芳基–C≡C–C≡C–Ph。新C–C键的两个碳分别来自对溴苄醇芳基碳和末端二炔碳；Br与末端炔氢离去。两个芳环、苄醇CH2OH、第二个内部炔和相对取代位置均保留，未发生环重排或额外官能团事件。选择性来自唯一末端炔位点，内部炔不参与；苄醇可在温和无水碱条件下耐受，必要时可先保护。Rachel gate inconclusive源于正向模板未再生目标和MCS歧义，但没有contradictions/proof_obligations；以明确断键/成键、两个骨架锚点及原子来源审计替代工具缺口。该单步把复杂片段降为可采购/可制备的对溴苄醇和苯基丁二炔，符合路线收敛。

protect_or_preserve: 保留两个L-α-立体中心及谷氨酸/赖氨酸碳骨架。

mode_evidence: 目标的两个手性α-氨基酸和脲/氨基甲酸酯连接均有明确局部位点证据（bond:6、bond:15）。
bond:23与bond:27显示双炔可拆为芳基卤化物和末端炔的两次交叉偶联，保留芳环拓扑并把高反应性炔基构建放在侧链组装之前。

两个α-手性中心在活化羰基/碱性条件下的消旋风险。
revision_triggers: 脲化或氨基甲酸酯化的原子映射/官能团兼容性出现硬矛盾。

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 以成熟的L-谷氨酸/L-赖氨酸脲核心为主线，采用混合型收敛路线：在Nα-Boc保护下先选择性安装赖氨酸ε-双炔苄基氨基甲酸酯，再脱去Nα-Boc并用phosgene把α-胺活化为异氰酸酯，与L-谷氨酸α-胺形成非对称脲；芳基支路用对溴苄醇与苯基丁-1,3-二炔进行一次Sonogashira，随后把苄醇转成氯甲酸酯；对苯基丁-1,3-二炔进一步提出一个独立的单步尝试：溴苯与丁-1,3-二炔的受控单Sonogashira。
key_disconnections: 目标脲键：L-谷氨酸α-胺与赖氨酸α-异氰酸酯。
赖氨酸Nε–CO–O–CH2–Ar：Nα-Boc-L-赖氨酸与芳基苄基氯甲酸酯。
芳基氯甲酸酯：双炔苄醇与phosgene；双炔苄醇：对溴苄醇与苯基丁-1,3-二炔的一次Sonogashira。
本次终端回溯尝试：苯基丁-1,3-二炔由溴苯与丁-1,3-二炔单次Sonogashira获得。
preferred_precursor_logic: Nα-Boc-L-谷氨酸与Nα-Boc-L-赖氨酸作为可采购手性终端；Boc在选择性事件后独立脱除。
将phosgene和三乙胺作为当前步试剂，不把它们加入路线树；芳基双炔碳由对溴苄醇/苯基丁二炔供给。
本次尝试将溴苯与丁-1,3-二炔作为路线节点，Pd/Cu/碱只作为当前步试剂；丁-1,3-二炔的另一末端必须保留为目标末端炔。
protect_or_preserve: 两个α-氨基酸的(S)构型、三羧酸拓扑和赖氨酸四碳侧链。
Nα-Boc直到ε-氨基甲酸酯形成后再脱除；双炔全程避免催化氢化。
本次事件中保留HC≡C–C≡C骨架的另一端，不能压缩成二次偶联。
mode_evidence: 当前mol10唯一反应位点是芳基sp2碳–二炔连接，结构证据支持以交叉偶联回溯。
单步尝试保留目标的HC≡C–C≡C拓扑，并将新增芳基碳来源明确分配给溴苯。
strategic_risks: 游离丁-1,3-二炔的双端等价，存在过度二芳基化、均偶联和聚合风险；单芳基化选择性需独立验证。
二炔在Pd/Cu/碱条件下可能发生氧化偶联或异构化，且产物可能继续参与第二次偶联。
双炔在后续氯甲酸酯与脲化条件下的稳定性仍需关注。
revision_triggers: 若沙盒显示原子/拓扑不守恒或无法区分单/双偶联，回退为预制苯基丁-1,3-二炔终端。
若二炔兼容性或选择性证据不足，不将该尝试提交为路线步骤。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the dye precursor is a standard N-ethyl-2-methyl-3,3-dimethylindolium salt and the second precursor is the preassembled oxygen-fused tetrahydrobenzocyclohexene aldehyde bearing the future aniline. Base-promoted condensation of the indolium C2 methyl (ylide/enamine equivalent) with the aldehyde, followed by dehydration, forms exactly the target trans C=C bridge at the non-ring site between the two fragments. The indolium N-ethyl/3,3-dimethyl benzene topology and the aldehyde fragment fused-ring topology are preserved; the aldehyde carbon becomes the terminal vinyl carbon and the indolium C2 methyl carbon becomes the other vinyl carbon. Piperidine/acetic anhydride are current-step activation/base components and are not route-bearing atoms. The aniline is unprotected but remains spectator under the mild, non-acylating condensation conditions; the cationic dye and ether ring are not exposed to strong oxidants or metals.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: N-ethyl-2-methyl-3,3-dimethylindolium is the electrophilic/cationic partner and the oxygen-fused aniline aldehyde is the carbonyl partner. Piperidine-mediated deprotonation of the indolium C2 methyl, addition to the aldehyde, and dehydration gives the single trans styryl C=C that connects the two pre-existing fragments. The aldehyde carbon and indolium methyl carbon are the only new bridge atoms; no ring atom is created or moved. The aniline, fused O-ring, indolium N-ethyl and gem-dimethyl anchors remain unchanged, and no strong acid or metal is used.

key_disconnections: 目标 α-胺脱Boc：N-Boc保护的完整探针作为独立前体，TFA或HCl/有机溶剂脱保护

protect_or_preserve: α-胺全程以Boc保护，最终独立脱除

保留半菁核心稠合醚和N-乙基季铵中心

reactions.rationale: 这是标准半菁缩合的一个真实事件：N-乙基-2-甲基-3,3-二甲基吲哚鎓盐的C2甲基在哌啶碱下形成亲核等价体，进攻氧杂稠合环醛，脱水生成目标反式苯乙烯桥。改变仅发生在醛碳与吲哚鎓C2甲基之间的非环位点；醛碳和甲基碳是新增桥的原子来源，N-乙基/3,3-二甲基吲哚鎓、氧杂稠合环、芳胺位置及所有环连接均保留。独立RDKit结构核查显示前体环数分别为2和3，合并产物环数为5，且产品bond:4为非环C=C；因此验证器报告的new_fused_ring是跨片段MCS映射假阳性，不是实际成环。哌啶为碱，未引入路线骨架；无强酸，故醚和乙烯醚兼容。E构型由共轭热力学和缩合条件主导。

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是一个独立的临时手柄安装：N-Boc保护的手性氨基酸醇在光气/吡啶下被选择性转化为末端O-氯甲酸酯。新羰基C和Cl由光气提供，原醇O-CH2CH2-S、甲酯、Boc和α-[C@H]构型均保留；没有C-C、C-S或N-Cα键变化。Boc屏蔽α-胺，硫醚在无氧、温和碱性条件下保持还原态。该氯甲酸酯只在下一步芳胺汇聚时使用，符合晚期安装高反应性手柄原则。验证的inconclusive来自无前向模板和副产物未建模，原子映射覆盖0.8636且无矛盾/位点漂移，因此不是化学否定。

selected_attempt.action_label: Install terminal chloroformate on protected sulfur-linked alcohol

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the route-bearing precursor is methyl (S)-2-(Boc-amino)-4-(2-hydroxyethylthio)butanoate, retaining the assigned alpha stereocenter and reduced thioether. Phosgene (or an equivalent carbonyl dichloride) converts only the terminal primary alcohol into the O-carbamoyl chloride, giving the exact chloroformate handle required for the later aromatic-amine capture. Pyridine scavenges HCl. The methyl ester and N-Boc carbamate are protected from the mild chlorocarbonylation conditions; no C-C, C-S, or stereocenter bond is edited. The new carbonyl C and Cl are supplied by the phosgene reagent, while O-CH2CH2-S and the amino-acid C skeleton are retained from the alcohol precursor. This is one late handle-installation event, not a compressed coupling.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是一个真实的N-乙基季铵化事件：中性2,3,3-三甲基-3H-吲哚烯的亚胺N对碘乙烷发生SN2烷基化，形成N-乙基吲哚鎓阳离子。乙基C2来自CCI，I−为离去/对离子；苯并环、C2甲基、3,3-二甲基桥头和亚胺拓扑均保留，没有环开裂或立体中心变化。该盐是随后与稠合环醛缩合的标准永久反应伙伴。验证只提示无前向模板与碘副产物未建模，原子映射覆盖0.8571且无位点矛盾，因此按化学证据提交。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: the route-bearing precursor is neutral 2,3,3-trimethyl-3H-indolenine (C11H13N), whose imine nitrogen is directly quaternized by ethyl iodide to give the N-ethyl indolium cation used in hemicyanine condensation. The ethyl carbon pair and iodide counterion source are explicit in CCI; the indolenine benzene ring, C2 methyl, gem-dimethyl bridgehead and imine topology are preserved, with no ring opening or stereochemical issue. This is a single SN2 alkylation/quaternization event and installs the permanent N-ethyl substituent before the aldehyde condensation.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: N-Boc methyl (S)-homocysteinate thiol is converted to its thiolate with mild K2CO3 in polar aprotic solvent and reacts by SN2 with 2-bromoethanol. The primary bromide carbon is the sole electrophilic site; the thiol sulfur becomes the new S-CH2 bond and the hydroxyethyl OH remains intact. K2CO3 is deliberately used instead of a strong organolithium/amide base, so the methyl ester and alpha stereocenter are not epimerized and the Boc group is retained. The two-carbon hydroxyethyl atom source is OCCBr; Br leaves. This is one convergent substitution event and sets up the later chloroformate installation.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 这是经典Fischer吲哚烯合成：苯肼与3-甲基-2-丁酮先形成腙，随后酸催化[3,3]重排、邻位进攻、脱氨闭合一个五元吲哚烯环。苯环保留为产物苯环；酮羰基C成为C2位、酮α-C成为3位桥头，酮的甲基/异丙基甲基提供C2-甲基和3,3-二甲基，N来自苯肼。产品由1个苯环变为与新五元环稠合的2环体系，没有未说明的碳源。验证器的MCS映射虽报告ring_count_increase和ambiguous，但这正是预期的Fischer成环，不是矛盾；独立结构/机制证据、环大小和原子来源均闭合，因此对拓扑proof_required使用有据可查的override。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: phenylhydrazine condenses with 3-methyl-2-butanone (methyl isopropyl ketone), then undergoes the classical acid-promoted Fischer rearrangement/cyclization to the fused 2,3,3-trimethyl-3H-indolenine. The phenyl ring supplies the six-membered benzene portion; the ketone carbonyl carbon and adjacent isopropyl carbon supply the two non-aromatic atoms of the five-membered N-ring, while the ketone methyl and isopropyl methyl groups account for the C2 and gem-dimethyl substituents. Acetic acid is a mild proton shuttle; water/ammonia are byproducts. The event intentionally creates one fused five-membered ring with the N-C and C-C junctions, preserves the benzene ring, and introduces no stereocenter.

The phenyl ring supplies the six-membered benzene portion; the ketone carbonyl carbon and adjacent isopropyl carbon supply the two non-aromatic atoms of the five-membered N-ring, while the ketone methyl and isopropyl methyl groups account for the C2 and gem-dimethyl substituents. Acetic acid is a mild proton shuttle; water/ammonia are byproducts. The event intentionally creates one fused five-membered ring with the N-C and C-C junctions, preserves the benzene ring, and introduces no stereocenter.

reactions.rationale: 这是经典Fischer吲哚烯合成：苯肼与3-甲基-2-丁酮先形成腙，随后酸催化[3,3]重排、邻位进攻、脱氨闭合一个五元吲哚烯环。苯环保留为产物苯环；酮羰基C成为C2位、酮α-C成为3位桥头，酮的甲基/异丙基甲基提供C2-甲基和3,3-二甲基，N来自苯肼。产品由1个苯环变为与新五元环稠合的2环体系，没有未说明的碳源。验证器的MCS映射虽报告ring_count_increase和ambiguous，但这正是预期的Fischer成环，不是矛盾；独立结构/机制证据、环大小和原子来源均闭合，因此对拓扑proof_required使用有据可查的override。

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: N-Boc-(S)-homocysteine is converted to its methyl ester by trimethylsilyldiazomethane, which transfers the diazomethyl carbon to the carboxylate oxygen and releases nitrogen and trimethylsilanol. The carboxyl carbon, alpha stereocenter, sulfur, Boc group, and side-chain topology are retained; only the acid OH is replaced by OCH3. The reagent is used as a current-step methylating reagent rather than a route-bearing fragment. The neutral/weakly basic conditions avoid acid-mediated Boc loss and minimize thiol oxidation or alkylation, so site fidelity and stereochemical retention are expected.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: L-homoserine (N[C@@H](CCO)C(=O)O) is converted to L-homocysteine by thiourea/HBr substitution at its terminal primary alcohol. HBr activates the primary OH as a leaving group; thiourea sulfur performs SN2 displacement to a beta-isothiouronium intermediate, and aqueous hydrolysis liberates the thiol. The new sulfur atom comes from thiourea; the two-carbon side chain, carboxyl group, alpha amine, and (S) alpha stereocenter come from L-homoserine. The reaction occurs at the primary beta-side-chain carbon, so no alpha stereochemical bond is broken and no new stereocenter is formed. The transformation is a single one-pot substitution/hydrolysis event with no hidden carbon or ring construction.

template_evidence.reaction_category: Chemoselective Fe/NH4Cl reduction of aryl nitro to aniline

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one chemoselective redox event. Mechanistically, Fe in aqueous alcoholic NH4Cl reduces the aryl nitro group through nitroso/hydroxylamine levels to the aniline; NH4Cl supplies protons and the two precursor nitro oxygens leave as water while Fe becomes inorganic iron salts. The aromatic attachment carbon is unchanged, so the precursor nitro N is the product amine N and all 14 carbons, both scaffold oxygens, the three fused six-membered rings, C7=C8, C12=C15 and the C12-CH2OH handle are retained. Rachel MCS coverage is 1.0 with zero C-C/C-O bonds formed or cleaved; strict site fidelity reports the same core and exactly one changed substituent, Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2. Fe/NH4Cl is compatible with a primary alcohol and is preferred over H2/Pd because the latter risks reducing both nonaromatic alkenes; mild buffered conditions and short exposure limit enol-ether hydrolysis. The validator is inconclusive only because no forward template is available and inorganic Fe/Cl/NH4 byproducts are not modeled; there is no chemical contradiction or proof obligation. This event directly supports route-plan revision 3 by carrying nitrogen as nitro through earlier scaffold chemistry and reducing it late.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Same chemically valid disconnection, but its executable record omits the reducing system and leaves both nitro oxygens unexplained; the selected custom action records Fe/NH4Cl and chemoselectivity explicitly.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: Convergent hybrid route: preserve the assembled NIR polymethine/cationic topology; derive the indolenine acceptor by Fischer synthesis, derive the chiral thioether amino-ester chain from L-homoserine through L-homocysteine, Boc/ester handling and S-alkylation,
key_disconnections: Late carbamate bond: oxygen-donor aryl amine plus activated 2-hydroxyethyl thioether amino-ester chain.
Polymethine connection: mature oxygen donor aldehyde/electrophilic handle plus Fischer-derived indolenine acceptor, with
mol_8 aryl C-N bond as late nitro reduction: nitro alcohol to amino alcohol without changing fused-ring topology.
mol_8 hydroxymethyl handle as aldehyde reduction, preceded by beta formylation of the unsubstituted cyclic enol ether.
preferred_precursor_logic: Use 5-nitrosalicylaldehyde, cyclohexanone, DMF-derived formyl carbon and hydride reduction to source the reopened oxygen donor scaffold and
Use phenylhydrazine and 3-methyl-2-butanone for the Fischer indolenine branch.
Use commercial L-homoserine as the stereochemical source, then explicit thiol formation, Boc protection, methyl esterification and 2-bromoet
protect_or_preserve: Preserve the two fused six-membered rings and all aryl substituent positions after mol_8 annulation.
Preserve the amino-acid alpha configuration inherited from L-homoserine.
Preserve mature indolenine and oxygen-donor scaffolds during late carbamate and polymethine assembly.
mode_evidence: The already committed branches validate a Fischer indolenine construction and a stereochemistry-preserving L-homoserine-to-thioether sequenc
For mol_8, the amino group is best carried as nitro during carbonyl chemistry, while the oxygen-fused diene is traced to a two-dehydration a
Late fragment union preserves mature rigid scaffolds and confines highly reactive polymethine and carbamate handles to the endgame.
strategic_risks: Chemoselective nitro reduction must avoid hydrogenating the two nonaromatic alkenes; use Fe/NH4Cl or SnCl2 rather than catalytic hydrogenation.
Vilsmeier formylation must occur at the beta carbon of the cyclic enol ether without opening or chlorinating the oxygen heterocycle.
The salicylaldehyde/cyclohexanone annulation must deliver both C7=C8 and C12=C15 at the recorded fused positions; incomplete dehydration or regioisomer formatio
The alpha stereocenter in the amino-acid branch must not racemize during esterification, Boc handling, S-alkylation, deprotection or final coupling.
revision_triggers: Failure of selective enol-ether beta formylation or evidence for ring opening should trigger an ester/formyl-handle alternative.
Failure of the double-dehydrative annulation topology should trigger stepwise benzylidene cyclohexanone formation and separately validated cyclodehydration.
Any nitro reduction condition that also reduces either scaffold alkene should trigger a non-hydrogenative reductant screen.
Any measurable loss of amino-acid enantiopurity should trigger revised protecting-group and base timing.

Rachel reports product coverage 1.0, no bond formation or cleavage, and strict site fidelity with exactly one changed substituent at the enol-ether beta carbon: [*]C=O to [*]CO; the nitro substituent is a preserved site. Low-temperature NaBH4 is chemoselective for the aldehyde and should leave the aryl nitro group, the fused C=C bond, the cyclic enol-ether C=C bond and all three six-membered rings intact. No assigned stereocenter exists or is created. llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one Vilsmeier-Haack C-H formylation. POCl3 converts DMF into the chloroiminium electrophile; the beta carbon of the polarized cyclic O-C=C bond attacks, loses its original H, and aqueous workup converts the iminium substituent into CHO. The formyl carbon is DMF's carbonyl carbon and the product carbonyl oxygen is furnished by hydrolysis; the remaining dimethylamino and phosphorus/chloride material leaves as unmodeled salts. The C13 nitro tricycle supplies every scaffold atom. Rachel finds the same core under strict site fidelity and exactly one changed site, addition of [*]C=O at the enol-ether beta carbon; the nitro substituent is preserved. Both fused pairs, all three six-membered rings, the aryl-fused C=C, and the enol-ether C=C bond order and position remain unchanged. Regioselectivity is electronic: the enol ether beta carbon bearing H is substantially more nucleophilic than the oxygen-bound alpha carbon or the separate aryl-fused alkene; the nitro group also deactivates the benzene ring toward competing electrophilic formylation. Controlled low-temperature reagent addition followed by prompt hydrolysis limits acid-mediated enol-ether opening. No stereocenter is involved. The inconclusive gate reflects absent forward-template coverage and unmodeled reagent fragments, not a contradiction. This is continuation step 0 of sketch:mol_16:0 and supports route-plan revision 3.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One site-selective C-H formylation. POCl3 activates DMF to a chloroiminium electrophile; the electron-rich beta carbon of the O-C=C unit attacks it, deprotonates, and hydrolytic workup gives the exocyclic aldehyde. The new CHO carbon is the DMF carbonyl carbon and its oxygen is supplied on hydrolysis; the C13 nitro-fused tricyclic core is unchanged. Regioselectivity follows the enol-ether polarization: electrophilic attack occurs at the beta carbon bearing H, not at the oxygen-bound alpha carbon or the less electron-rich aryl-fused alkene. Nitro is compatible and intentionally suppresses competing arene electrophilic substitution.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one intramolecular cyclodehydration, with explicit topology proof. Catalytic p-TsOH protonates the ketone; the tethered ortho phenol attacks the ketone carbon to form a six-membered cyclic hemiacetal, and azeotropic removal of water eliminates the original ketone oxygen plus the phenol/adjacent alpha hydrogens to give the enol ether. Exact source/map: precursor phenol O13 and ketone C1 form product O16-C15; precursor C17-C1 changes from single to product C14=C15; precursor benzylidene C3=C2 remains product C9=C10. The precursor and product formulas, C13H13NO4 and C13H11NO3, differ by exactly H2O. All 13 carbons and the nitro N/O atoms remain in one route-bearing molecule. Preserved independent anchors are the complete aromatic ring with nitro at precursor C6/product C3, the preformed benzylidene double bond, and the cyclohexanone chain C2-C14-C15-C16-C17-C1. These anchors enforce the observed 6-6-6 topology and both fusion sites; the only new heavy-atom bond is the tethered O-C ring bond and only the adjacent ketone-alpha bond changes order. A carbonyl attack closes a favorable six-membered ring; phenoxy attack at the enone alpha/beta sites would require disfavored five-/four-member rings and cannot give the audited topology. Nitro is stable to catalytic sulfonic acid; no stereocenter is assigned, and the preformed benzylidene geometry can equilibrate under acid before irreversible water removal. Rachel independently reports product coverage 1.0, one formed bond, the expected bond-order/topology changes and no contradiction. The proof-required gate is therefore satisfied by the indexed atom map, exact H2O balance, same-molecule tether and three preserved anchors. This realizes continuation step 0 and supports route-plan revision 4.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One intramolecular cyclodehydration under catalytic p-TsOH with water removal. Protonation of the cyclohexanone carbonyl enables the tethered ortho phenol oxygen to attack the ketone carbon, closing a six-membered O ring; dehydration then removes the original ketone oxygen together with the phenol proton and an alpha hydrogen as H2O, and establishes the adjacent enol-ether C=C. All 13 carbons and nitro N/O atoms come from the single benzylidene ketone. Exact mapping: precursor phenol O13 bonds to ketone C1 to give product O16-C15; precursor C17-C1 becomes product C14=C15; precursor benzylidene C3=C2 remains product C9=C10. The aromatic ring, nitro position, benzylidene alkene and four-carbon cyclohexanone chain are preserved. Six-member tether closure is favored; only one ortho phenol and one ketone are present, limiting regioisomeric closure.

reactions.rationale: Commit one intramolecular cyclodehydration, with explicit topology proof. Catalytic p-TsOH protonates the ketone; the tethered ortho phenol attacks the ketone carbon to form a six-membered cyclic hemiacetal, and azeotropic removal of water eliminates the original ketone oxygen plus the phenol/adjacent alpha hydrogens to give the enol ether. Exact source/map: precursor phenol O13 and ketone C1 form product O16-C15; precursor C17-C1 changes from single to product C14=C15; precursor benzylidene C3=C2 remains product C9=C10. The precursor and product formulas, C13H13NO4 and C13H11NO3, differ by exactly H2O. All 13 carbons and the nitro N/O atoms remain in one route-bearing molecule. Preserved independent anchors are the complete aromatic ring with nitro at precursor C6/product C3, the preformed benzylidene double bond, and the cyclohexanone chain C2-C14-C15-C16-C17-C1. These anchors enforce the observed 6-6-6 topology and both fusion sites; the only new heavy-atom bond is the tethered O-C ring bond and only the adjacent ketone-alpha bond changes order. A carbonyl attack closes a favorable six-membered ring; phenoxy attack at the enone alpha/beta sites would require disfavored five-/four-member rings and cannot give the audited topology. Nitro is stable to catalytic sulfonic acid; no stereocenter is assigned, and the preformed benzylidene geometry can equilibrate under acid before irreversible water removal. Rachel independently reports product coverage 1.0, one formed bond, the expected bond-order/topology changes and no contradiction. The proof-required gate is therefore satisfied by the indexed atom map, exact H2O balance, same-molecule tether and three preserved anchors. This realizes continuation step 0 and supports route-plan revision 4.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one piperidine-catalyzed Knoevenagel condensation. Cyclohexanone forms an enamine/enolate at either symmetry-equivalent alpha carbon, attacks the 5-nitrosalicylaldehyde carbonyl, then the beta-hydroxy intermediate loses the aldehyde oxygen and an alpha hydrogen as H2O to form the conjugated benzylidene double bond. Atom sources are complete: product ketone O0=C1 and all six ring carbons derive from cyclohexanone; product alkene C2 derives from a cyclohexanone alpha carbon; product benzylidene C3-H derives from the aldehyde formyl C-H; the aromatic ring, phenol oxygen, nitro N/O and their relative positions derive unchanged from 5-nitrosalicylaldehyde. Formula accounting closes exactly: C7H5NO4 + C6H10O - H2O = C13H13NO4. Strict site fidelity reports the same salicylaldehyde core and exactly one site change, CHO to CH=C1CCCCC1=O, while phenol and nitro sites are preserved. A 1:1 aldehyde-limited charge, slow ketone addition and mild piperidine/acetic acid suppress cyclohexanone self-condensation and bis-benzylidene formation; the two alpha sites are constitutionally equivalent before substitution. The product has unspecified alkene stereo, so a thermodynamic E-rich mixture is not a hidden stereochemical claim and can equilibrate during the next acid cyclization. Rachel's partial MCS coverage is a fragment-merge tool limitation, not missing atoms; there is no contradiction or proof obligation. This completes continuation step 1 and supports route-plan revision 4.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: One intermolecular Knoevenagel condensation. Piperidine generates the cyclohexanone enamine/enolate, which adds to the 5-nitrosalicylaldehyde carbonyl; beta-hydroxy elimination then expels the aldehyde oxygen and an alpha hydrogen as H2O to form the conjugated benzylidene C=C. Product ketone O0=C1 and the entire six-carbon ring come from cyclohexanone; product alkene C2 is one of its two symmetry-equivalent alpha carbons; product benzylidene C3-H is the salicylaldehyde formyl C1-H. The salicylaldehyde aromatic ring, ortho phenol and nitro substituent are unchanged. Aldehyde-limited 1:1 addition and mild catalytic piperidine/acetic acid minimize cyclohexanone self-condensation and bis-benzylidene formation. The thermodynamic less-hindered alkene geometry is expected, but the recorded product has unspecified alkene stereo and acid cyclization can equilibrate it.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one regioselective electrophilic aromatic nitration. Cold nitric acid in acetic acid supplies nitronium character; salicylaldehyde undergoes substitution at C5, para to phenol and meta to aldehyde. reactions.label: Mitsunobu N-alkylation of sulfamide

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Mechanistically real Mitsunobu substitution: PPh3/DIAD activates the secondary piperidinol, and the acidic bicyclic sulfamide NH attacks the mapped C4 carbon with SN2 inversion to form the C4-N sulfamide junction. The piperidine fragment supplies the C4 carbon and retains its Boc-protected 2-aminoethyl handle; the sulfamide precursor supplies the new N and the complete chiral bicyclic imide-sulfamide scaffold, including the sole (S) bridgehead. No ring is opened or built, and the preserved anchors are the Boc carbamate, both imide carbonyls, and the bridgehead. Rachel reports no contradictions or proof obligations and a mapped site-retentive junction. The generic strong-base FG warning is not chemically applicable to PPh3/DIAD Mitsunobu conditions; it is treated as a family-classification caution, not disproof. This step supports the explicit protection and stereochemical strategy.

The BF2 chelate, N-heteroaromatic topology, methyl substituents, and all bond orders in the core are preserved. The forward-template gap and unmodeled Br/Zn byproducts are tool limitations, not chemical contradictions; atom sources are explicit and the substrate/reagent set is closed-shell. The methyl ester is intentionally retained for a separately committed hydrolysis step, which is milder and more compatible than coupling a free carboxylic acid.

Atom balance is balanced, the target similarity is 1.0, and the clear decision gate has no contradictions or proof obligations. The lower MCS coverage is a mapping limitation from the large protected linker, not evidence of a changed scaffold. The step supports the hybrid plan by assembling the second steroid core only after masking the future dye amine.

reactions.rationale: This is one real acid-chloride amidation of the last PEG carboxamide. The PEG acid chloride contributes the carbonyl carbon, oxygen, and chloride leaving group; the double-protected triamine contributes the single unprotected primary amine. The Boc and Fmoc carbamates remain intact and block the two other amines, giving direct chemoselectivity. The PEG ether chain, existing amide, Boc/Fmoc topology, and all carbon skeleton atoms are preserved. Atom balance is balanced, product similarity is 1.0, and the gate is clear with no contradictions or proof obligations. Partial MCS coverage is a mapping limitation for the protected flexible linker, not a scaffold change. This event supports the convergent assembly and leaves an orthogonally protected triamine for controlled deprotection/terminal coupling.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This is one real acid-chloride formation from the amino-PEG hydrochloride salt. The terminal amine is explicitly protonated as [NH3+] with [Cl-], suppressing nucleophilic self-acylation while SOCl2 converts only the carboxyl group to the acid chloride. The PEG carbon/oxygen skeleton and all five ether units are retained; the acid OH is replaced by chlorine sourced from SOCl2. Salt chloride, sulfur dioxide, HCl, and other SOCl2 byproducts are not product atoms. The product mapping coverage is 0.9524 with no contradictions; the forward-template gap and byproduct imbalance are tool limitations. The acid chloride is consumed immediately in the next coupling, so no unstable free-amine acid chloride is isolated. The listed free-amine SOCl2 action was rejected because it leaves the amine unprotected under strongly activating conditions.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Free primary amine was left unprotected during SOCl2 activation; the hydrochloride-salt custom realization provides a credible compatibility control.

In the forward direction, Boc2O undergoes nucleophilic acyl substitution at one of the two constitutionally equivalent free terminal primary amines of mono-Fmoc TREN; the Boc carbonyl and tert-butyl atoms are sourced from Boc2O, while the Fmoc carbamate, tertiary TREN nitrogen, and PEG-like fluorenyl carbamate topology are retained. The event restores mol_18 as a properly sourced protected linker for the already-committed acid-chloride amidation; it replaces the retracted rxn_15 self-loop with a genuine graph-changing protection step. The forward-template miss and unmodeled Boc2O byproducts are tool limits, not chemical contradictions; the strict site audit maps one changed terminal-amine site and preserves the entire retained scaffold.

TREN has three symmetry-equivalent terminal primary amines, so controlled substoichiometric Fmoc-Cl (with excess TREN and isolation of the mono-Fmoc fraction) gives a single constitutional mono-protected building block; no regioisomeric arm identity is chemically meaningful before the first differentiation. The tertiary central amine remains unchanged, and the resulting mono-Fmoc linker is the exact precursor required for the next mono-Boc protection. This is a single protection event and closes the active route-sketch continuation without compressing the two protections.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This bounded terminal-review event converts 9-fluorenylmethanol to Fmoc-Cl by chloroformylation. The fluorenylmethanol precursor supplies the complete fluorene ring system and benzylic OCH2 topology; triphosgene supplies the new carbamoyl carbon and chlorine, and alcoholysis leaves the chloroformate acyl chloride. No aromatic or fused-ring bond is formed, opened, or rearranged, and the strict site audit maps only the alcohol-to-chloroformate functional-group change. Triphosgene is a contained phosgene equivalent with explicit hazardous-reagent handling; its excess atoms appear as unmodeled byproducts, a validator warning rather than a product-source gap. Fmoc-Cl is consumed immediately in the next mono-Fmoc TREN protection, so this step is route-coherent and closes the advanced-terminal review with a real event.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: 提交一个真实的末端芳基硼化事件。机制为Pd催化的Miyaura borylation：对苄基芳环的C-Br位发生氧化加成、转金属化和还原消除，B2pin2提供保留在产物中的硼原子；水解/酸化把芳基B(pin)转为B(OH)2，溴以溴离子离去。验证显示无contradictions，MCS覆盖率0.9211，site_fidelity为mapped且仅有一个预期位点改变：[*]Cc1ccc(Br)cc1 -> [*]Cc1ccc(B(O)O)cc1；两个核心锚点和烯桥拓扑保持。硼酸后装避免其经历前序强碱/金属化，芳基溴位点相对双阳离子杂环具有明确选择性。B2pin2和水解水分别提供B与OH来源，pinacol/无机溴为副产物。拒绝listed fgi:1仅因其未显式记录B2pin2/水解来源，不是拒绝该化学事件。自定义动作的inconclusive状态来自无前向模板工具覆盖，而非化学矛盾；以独立机制、位点映射和原子来源证据覆盖该工具限制。

Diethylamine/acetic anhydride provide a mild basic/dehydrating medium; no new ring atoms are introduced. E geometry is selected by conjugation and anti arrangement of the two bulky heteroaryl cations, with Z as the principal selectivity risk. This directly realizes the target bridge and aligns with the revised electronic-state strategy.

The benzyl carbon comes from BrCH2-C6H4-Br; the aryl Br is retained as the later Miyaura handle, while the benzylic Br leaves. N-selectivity is intrinsic to the imine nitrogen, and using a primary benzyl bromide favors SN2 over elimination.

protect_or_preserve: 芳基溴作为后续硼化永久把手

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one chemically coherent late N-alkylation event. Mechanism: carbonate-assisted deprotonation of the naphthalimide NH followed by intermolecular SN2 attack on the primary bromide of BrCH2CH2OCH2CH2OCH2CH2C(=O)OCH2-pyridyl-core; bromide is the leaving atom and no stereocenter is created. Site/topology: the only intended product change is formation of the C33-N34 bond at the mapped alkyl_sp3_c-amide_n site; the two naphthalimide carbonyls, boronic-acid aryl carbon, aldehyde/phenol/naphthyl-quinoline core, pyridine, aryl ether, and ester topology are retained, and no ring is formed or opened. Atom sources: every new carbon in the PEG ester chain is present in the bromide precursor; N is the pre-existing imide N; Br and inorganic carbonate/KI atoms are leaving/byproduct components, while DMF is solvent and not a product atom source. Compatibility/selectivity: a primary bromide and K2CO3/DMF are standard mild conditions for N-alkylation of imides and avoid strong organometallic reagents; boronic acid and aldehyde survival remain explicit risks but are preferable to the stronger-base alternatives. Validation reconciliation: strict site-fidelity mapping passed, no contradictions or proof obligations were reported; the fused-ring warning is an MCS fragment-merge artifact inconsistent with the declared SN2 graph delta, and forward-template absence is a tool limit rather than disproof. The listed reductive-amination alternative was rejected because an imide N is resonance-deactivated and no carbonyl/NH pair supports that mechanism. This event supports the route plan by installing the late PEG handle before final terminal review.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用可独立表征的卤代喹啉、羟基甲酰基萘硼酸酯、受保护PEG卤化物和萘酰亚胺硼酸酯。
每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。
在强碱/金属偶联前保护游离酚和醛基，避免副反应；把脱保护作为独立树步骤。
mode_evidence: 目标含7个芳香环、两个稠合内酰亚胺/酰亚胺单元和硼酸，直接从头组装全部骨架会放大拓扑与选择性风险。
目标中醛基、酯键、苄基醚和末端胺链是明确的晚期官能团化把手，适合与成熟多环片段汇合。
芳基-芳基连接与受体片段接入应作为单独真实事件验证，不能压缩为一步。
strategic_risks: 喹啉/吡啶多氮芳杂环的区域选择性和碱敏感性可能限制交叉偶联与醚化顺序。

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。

reactions.label: Suzuki Coupling

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit the convergent Suzuki coupling at the mapped non-ring aryl_sp2_c-aryl_sp2_c bond 12. Mechanism: Pd-catalyzed transmetalation from the quinoline-side aryl-B(OH)2 followed by reductive elimination with the bromonaphthol aryl-Br forms one biaryl C-C bond; carbonate/base and aqueous workup account for boron/halide byproducts. Atom source is explicit: the new C-C bond joins the two mapped ipso carbons (product atoms 12 and 13), with the naphthol carbon supplied by the bromide precursor and the quinoline carbon supplied by the boronic-acid precursor; B and Br are leaving atoms, not missing product atoms. Topology/site fidelity: both pre-existing naphthalene/quinoline ring systems remain intact, no ring is formed, opened, fused, or rearranged, and the aldehyde, phenol, pyridine, aryl ether, ester, and terminal primary bromide are retained for later steps. Handle timing: the terminal alkyl bromide is carried through the Pd/base event as a deliberate later N-alkylation handle; no organometallic reagent is introduced that would attack the aldehyde or ester. Suzuki was preferred over Negishi/Kumada/Stille because it uses closed-shell, isolable aryl boronic acid/aryl bromide partners and milder conditions compatible with the ester and alkyl bromide. Validation reconciliation: no contradictions were reported; the forward-template miss and B/Br/O remainder are tool/byproduct accounting limits. The proof-required new-fused-ring flag is a false positive from MCS fragment merging: the declared graph delta is exactly one interfragment bond formation between two non-ring atoms, with preserved anchors on each aromatic scaffold.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Negishi would require a highly reactive aryl-zinc precursor in the presence of aldehyde, ester, phenol, pyridine, and alkyl bromide; Suzuki offers more stable handles.
Kumada organomagnesium chemistry is unnecessarily harsh and poorly compatible with the aldehyde/ester and terminal bromide.
Stille requires a separately prepared organotin fragment and adds toxic tin burden without a mechanistic advantage.

reactions.rationale: Commit the convergent Suzuki coupling at the mapped non-ring aryl_sp2_c-aryl_sp2_c bond 12. Mechanism: Pd-catalyzed transmetalation from the quinoline-side aryl-B(OH)2 followed by reductive elimination with the bromonaphthol aryl-Br forms one biaryl C-C bond; carbonate/base and aqueous workup account for boron/halide byproducts. Atom source is explicit: the new C-C bond joins the two mapped ipso carbons (product atoms 12 and 13), with the naphthol carbon supplied by the bromide precursor and the quinoline carbon supplied by the boronic-acid precursor; B and Br are leaving atoms, not missing product atoms. Topology/site fidelity: both pre-existing naphthalene/quinoline ring systems remain intact, no ring is formed, opened, fused, or rearranged, and the aldehyde, phenol, pyridine, aryl ether, ester, and terminal primary bromide are retained for later steps. Handle timing: the terminal alkyl bromide is carried through the Pd/base event as a deliberate later N-alkylation handle; no organometallic reagent is introduced that would attack the aldehyde or ester. Suzuki was preferred over Negishi/Kumada/Stille because it uses closed-shell, isolable aryl boronic acid/aryl bromide partners and milder conditions compatible with the ester and alkyl bromide. Validation reconciliation: no contradictions were reported; the forward-template miss and B/Br/O remainder are tool/byproduct accounting limits. The proof-required new-fused-ring flag is a false positive from MCS fragment merging: the declared graph delta is exactly one interfragment bond formation between two non-ring atoms, with preserved anchors on each aromatic scaffold.
