llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one Miyaura borylation/protection event. Mechanism: Pd oxidative addition into aryl C7-Br8, B2pin2 transmetalation under carbonate, and reductive elimination to the aryl-Bpin product; pinacolato O-C/B-O connectivity is formed within the reagent-derived protecting group. Atom sources are explicit: aryl C7 and the whole naphthalimide scaffold come from O=C1NC(=O)c2cc(Br)cc3cccc1c23; boron and pinacol carbons/oxygens come from CC1(C)OB(B2OC(C)(C)C(C)(C)O2)OC1(C)C; Br and the second Bpin fragment are byproducts. Topology: one new five-membered B-O-C-C-C-O ring belongs to the boronate protecting group, while the naphthalimide fused ring system and imide carbonyl/N anchors are unchanged; the strict site audit mapped only the aryl substituent change Br -> Bpin. No stereocenter is created. Handle timing: Bpin is the protected coupling handle used in the previously committed Suzuki branch, and hydrolysis to B(OH)2 is already a separate committed event. The validator found no contradictions or proof obligations; forward-template absence and unmodeled B2pin2/base byproducts are tool/accounting limits. The listed fgi preview was rejected because its reagent list omitted the boron donor.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用可独立表征的卤代喹啉、羟基甲酰基萘硼酸酯、受保护PEG卤化物和萘酰亚胺硼酸酯。
每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。
在强碱/金属偶联前保护游离酚和醛基，避免副反应；把脱保护作为独立树步骤。
mode_evidence: 目标含7个芳香环、两个稠合内酰亚胺/酰亚胺单元和硼酸，直接从头组装全部骨架会放大拓扑与选择性风险。
目标中醛基、酯键、苄基醚和末端胺链是明确的晚期官能团化把手，适合与成熟多环片段汇合。
芳基-芳基连接与受体片段接入应作为单独真实事件验证，不能压缩为一步。
strategic_risks: 喹啉/吡啶多氮芳杂环的区域选择性和碱敏感性可能限制交叉偶联与醚化顺序。
硼酸、醛基和游离胺在氧化、强碱和金属条件下存在保护/兼容性问题。
末端多醚链的SN2或酯化可能与芳杂环氮发生副反应，需明确保护与原子来源。
revision_triggers: 位点地图显示关键芳基连接无法由晚期偶联保持拓扑时，转向非最终电子态或骨架组装。
验证发现硼酸/醛基在计划偶联条件下不可兼容时，改为硼酸酯晚装或醛基后氧化/甲酰化。
若PEG-胺链只能通过不可靠的非选择性烷基化接入，则先重订保护-脱保护和酯化顺序。

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one Vilsmeier-Haack formylation event. Mechanism: DMF and POCl3 generate the Vilsmeier electrophile; the bromonaphthol undergoes electrophilic aromatic substitution at the mapped carbon, and aqueous workup converts the iminium to the aldehyde. Atom source: the new formyl carbon and oxygen are supplied by DMF/workup; the naphthalene, phenol, and aryl-Br atoms all come from Oc1c(Br)ccc2ccccc12, while POCl3 and chloride are activating/leaving components. Site fidelity mapping passed with exactly one new aryl-C(=O)H substituent and preserved aromatic anchors; no ring topology or stereochemistry changes. Regioselectivity is governed by the naphthol directing effect and the pre-existing bromine pattern, and the chosen mapped site reproduces the target aldehyde while retaining aryl bromide for the committed Suzuki event. Conditions are compatible with an aryl bromide and avoid metal-halogen exchange. The listed fgi preview was rejected because it omitted DMF/POCl3 and was chemically blocked by a one-carbon skeleton imbalance; the completed action closes that atom-source obligation. Validator reported no contradictions or proof obligations; unmodeled DMF/POCl3/water byproducts and missing forward template are accounting/tool limits.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。

每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。

reactions.label: Ammonolysis and cyclodehydration of 4-bromonaphthalic anhydride

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one anhydride-to-imide condensation/cyclodehydration event. Mechanism: ammonia (SMILES N) opens one anhydride carbonyl, generates the amic-acid intermediate, and cyclodehydrates to the N-H naphthalimide with water loss. Atom sources are complete and sandbox atom balance is true: the imide N comes from ammonia, both carbonyl carbons and the aryl-Br framework come from O=C1OC(=O)c2cc(Br)cc3cccc1c23. Topology: the non-aromatic five-membered anhydride ring is converted to the same-size imide ring through explicit C1-N2 and N2-C3 acyl bonds; the naphthalene fused-ring anchors, two carbonyl positions, and aryl bromide position are preserved. The observed ring-bond edit and ambiguous MCS mapping match the declared O-to-N ring atom replacement, not an unsupported scaffold rearrangement. No stereocenter is present. The aryl bromide survives standard imidization, enabling the later B2pin2 borylation. Listed amide/lactam actions were rejected because their two-fragment preview duplicates part of the aromatic skeleton and fails to identify ammonia as the source of the single imide N. The only validator limitation is lack of a custom forward template; there are no contradictions or proof obligations.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The lactam preview splits a single naphthalene skeleton into overlapping fragments and does not provide the correct ammonia atom source; it does not represent the anhydride imidization chemistry.
The amide-bond preview treats the cyclic imide as disconnected acyl chloride/amide fragments rather than the direct anhydride-plus-ammonia condensation.

reactions.rationale: Commit one anhydride-to-imide condensation/cyclodehydration event. Mechanism: ammonia (SMILES N) opens one anhydride carbonyl, generates the amic-acid intermediate, and cyclodehydrates to the N-H naphthalimide with water loss. Topology: the non-aromatic five-membered anhydride ring is converted to the same-size imide ring through explicit C1-N2 and N2-C3 acyl bonds; the naphthalene fused-ring anchors, two carbonyl positions, and aryl bromide position are preserved. Listed amide/lactam actions were rejected because their two-fragment preview duplicates part of the aromatic skeleton and fails to identify ammonia as the source of the single imide N. The only validator limitation is lack of a custom forward template; there are no contradictions or proof obligations.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one acid-chloride activation event. Mechanism: SOCl2 converts the carboxylic acid via chlorosulfite activation to O=C(Cl)CCOCCOCCBr, releasing SO2/HCl; catalytic DMF accelerates activation. Atom sources: the complete seven-carbon polyether-bromide chain is carried by O=C(O)CCOCCOCCBr, and the replacing acyl chloride originates from SOCl2. The terminal primary C-Br, two ether bonds, and all carbon skeleton positions are preserved; no stereochemistry or ring topology changes. Acid chloride is formed immediately before the committed esterification to avoid unnecessary exposure of an acyl halide. The system fgi preview was rejected solely for omitting SOCl2/DMF and therefore leaving atom-source/reagent roles incomplete. Validation has no contradiction or proof obligation; the remaining unmodeled SOCl2/DMF byproducts and lack of a forward template are expected limits.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用可独立表征的卤代喹啉、羟基甲酰基萘硼酸酯、受保护PEG卤化物和萘酰亚胺硼酸酯。
每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。
在强碱/金属偶联前保护游离酚和醛基，避免副反应；把脱保护作为独立树步骤。
mode_evidence: 目标含7个芳香环、两个稠合内酰亚胺/酰亚胺单元和硼酸，直接从头组装全部骨架会放大拓扑与选择性风险。
目标中醛基、酯键、苄基醚和末端胺链是明确的晚期官能团化把手，适合与成熟多环片段汇合。
芳基-芳基连接与受体片段接入应作为单独真实事件验证，不能压缩为一步。
strategic_risks: 喹啉/吡啶多氮芳杂环的区域选择性和碱敏感性可能限制交叉偶联与醚化顺序。
硼酸、醛基和游离胺在氧化、强碱和金属条件下存在保护/兼容性问题。
末端多醚链的SN2或酯化可能与芳杂环氮发生副反应，需明确保护与原子来源。
revision_triggers: 位点地图显示关键芳基连接无法由晚期偶联保持拓扑时，转向非最终电子态或骨架组装。
验证发现硼酸/醛基在计划偶联条件下不可兼容时，改为硼酸酯晚装或醛基后氧化/甲酰化。
若PEG-胺链只能通过不可靠的非选择性烷基化接入，则先重订保护-脱保护和酯化顺序。

reactions.label: Regioselective electrophilic bromination of 1,8-naphthalic anhydride

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one electrophilic aromatic bromination event, with the selectivity limit stated explicitly. Br2 supplies the only added Br atom; substitution of the product-mapped aryl H gives HBr, while H2SO4 is a non-incorporated acidic activation medium and its atoms are correctly absent from the product graph. Strict site fidelity maps a single change from an unsubstituted aryl carbon to C-Br and preserves both anhydride carbonyl anchors and all fused-ring bonds. The parent anhydride has symmetry-equivalent 4/5 sites, so those labels do not create constitutional ambiguity; however, the available validation does not establish exclusion of the 2/3 regioisomers. That unresolved experimental selectivity is a residual risk requiring analytical confirmation, not a reason to invent a different connectivity. No stereocenter, protecting group, or ring topology changes. The event supports the recorded late installation of the bromo handle before ammonolysis and Miyaura borylation. The generic listed halogenation action was rejected only because it lacked an explicit Br source; it is not rejected as a different chemical disconnection.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: Br2 is the sole bromine source for electrophilic aromatic substitution on 1,8-naphthalic anhydride under strongly activating acidic conditions; sulfuric acid is a non-incorporated medium/activator. The event replaces one aryl H with Br without altering either anhydride carbonyl, the fused naphthalene topology, or any ring connectivity. The designated 4 and 5 positions are symmetry-equivalent in the parent anhydride, so their interconversion is not a constitutional-product issue; the remaining selectivity question is discrimination from the 2/3 positions and is retained as a validation risk rather than assumed away. HBr is the expected unmodeled small-molecule byproduct. This is one late handle-installation event supporting the established bromo-anhydride -> imide -> Bpin sequence.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: This commit records one EAS bromination, not an invented cross-coupling: Br2 supplies the product-mapped aromatic bromine, one aryl H is lost as HBr, and the entire 1-methoxynaphthalene skeleton including the OMe carbon/oxygen is preserved. Strict mapping shows one C-Br installation and preserves the methoxy-bearing aromatic anchor; no ring bonds, C-C bonds, stereocenters, or protecting groups change. The methoxy group is intentionally carried as a reversible electronic/directing handle and will be removed in the already committed BBr3 event, so it is not a methylation-demethylation loop. The validator cannot discriminate competing naphthalene EAS sites; therefore regioselectivity is an explicit reaction-development and product-analysis requirement, not an asserted fact. The generic FGI action was rejected only because it omitted Br2 atom accounting. This retains a practical aryl-bromide handle for the planned late FGI and Suzuki sequence.

The aryl methoxy group remains intact and provides a reversible electronic/directing handle before its later BBr3 cleavage; no C-C or ring bond changes occur. The product's exact C-Br site is the product-mapped aromatic position, and all naphthalene atoms and the OMe carbon are retained. Because the available tool lacks an experimental regioselectivity model, positional selectivity versus other activated naphthalene sites remains an explicit analytical-development risk rather than a claimed validation result. The step aligns with late installation of the aryl bromide required for subsequent formylation/Suzuki sequence.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用可独立表征的卤代喹啉、羟基甲酰基萘硼酸酯、受保护PEG卤化物和萘酰亚胺硼酸酯。
每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。
在强碱/金属偶联前保护游离酚和醛基，避免副反应；把脱保护作为独立树步骤。
mode_evidence: 目标含7个芳香环、两个稠合内酰亚胺/酰亚胺单元和硼酸，直接从头组装全部骨架会放大拓扑与选择性风险。
目标中醛基、酯键、苄基醚和末端胺链是明确的晚期官能团化把手，适合与成熟多环片段汇合。
芳基-芳基连接与受体片段接入应作为单独真实事件验证，不能压缩为一步。
strategic_risks: 喹啉/吡啶多氮芳杂环的区域选择性和碱敏感性可能限制交叉偶联与醚化顺序。
硼酸、醛基和游离胺在氧化、强碱和金属条件下存在保护/兼容性问题。
末端多醚链的SN2或酯化可能与芳杂环氮发生副反应，需明确保护与原子来源。
revision_triggers: 位点地图显示关键芳基连接无法由晚期偶联保持拓扑时，转向非最终电子态或骨架组装。
验证发现硼酸/醛基在计划偶联条件下不可兼容时，改为硼酸酯晚装或醛基后氧化/甲酰化。
若PEG-胺链只能通过不可靠的非选择性烷基化接入，则先重订保护-脱保护和酯化顺序。

reactions.rationale: This commit records one EAS bromination, not an invented cross-coupling: Br2 supplies the product-mapped aromatic bromine, one aryl H is lost as HBr, and the entire 1-methoxynaphthalene skeleton including the OMe carbon/oxygen is preserved. Strict mapping shows one C-Br installation and preserves the methoxy-bearing aromatic anchor; no ring bonds, C-C bonds, stereocenters, or protecting groups change. The methoxy group is intentionally carried as a reversible electronic/directing handle and will be removed in the already committed BBr3 event, so it is not a methylation-demethylation loop. The validator cannot discriminate competing naphthalene EAS sites; therefore regioselectivity is an explicit reaction-development and product-analysis requirement, not an asserted fact. The generic FGI action was rejected only because it omitted Br2 atom accounting. This retains a practical aryl-bromide handle for the planned late FGI and Suzuki sequence.

metadata.reaction_type: TFA deprotection of tert-butyl PEG carboxylate

template_evidence.reaction_category: TFA deprotection of tert-butyl PEG carboxylate

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one explicit protecting-group removal. TFA protonates the tert-butyl carboxylate and promotes cleavage of the tert-butyl C-O bond; the product carboxylic acid retains the acyl carbon and both acyl oxygens of the precursor. The four tert-butyl carbons are removed as isobutene/tert-butanol-derived material, while TFA is an acid promoter and is not incorporated. The PEG carbon/ether sequence and the terminal C-Br bond are unchanged, so there is no site migration, ring edit, or stereochemical issue. Acidic, nonnucleophilic conditions are deliberately chosen over saponification to avoid hydroxide displacement at the primary bromide. The validator's unmodeled TFA atoms and missing structured mechanism keys reflect acid/byproduct representation rather than a chemical contradiction. This step cleanly delivers the acid immediately upstream of the committed SOCl2 activation and preserves the plan's handle timing.

The tert-butyl carbons leave as isobutene/tert-butanol-type small-molecule material; TFA is a non-incorporated acid reagent. No C-C, C-O ether, ring, or stereochemical change is made. Acidic, nonnucleophilic deprotection avoids hydroxide-mediated displacement at the primary bromide and supplies the acid immediately before the already committed SOCl2 activation/esterification sequence.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit only the Bpin-to-boronic-acid hydrolysis. Water provides the hydroxy ligands at boron; the C6 pinacolato ligand leaves as a pinacol-derived small-molecule fragment, accounting for the graph's loss of the Bpin ring and its carbons. The aryl C-B bond is retained at the strict mapped site, as are every naphthalene carbon and the phenolic O; the observed ring-count decrease belongs only to the departing protecting ligand, not the aromatic scaffold. No C-C bond, aryl topology, stereocenter, or phenol substitution changes. The forward-template absence and coarse atom-balance warning are tool/byproduct limits, not evidence against ligand exchange. This is the first planned continuation event and preserves the separation between Bpin formation and subsequent hydrolysis.

The product's aryl C-B bond, phenolic oxygen, and all naphthalene carbons are retained at the mapped site, with no C-C/ring/stereochemical change. This isolates hydrolysis from the later Pd/B2pin2 C-B installation and avoids claiming a free boronic acid is produced in the same event as oxidative addition/transmetalation.

TBSCl supplies the complete Si/tert-butyl/dimethyl protecting group and imidazole activates the alcohol; chloride/imidazolium material is non-product. llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one Williamson O-methylation. K2CO3 forms the 1-naphthoxide, which attacks methyl iodide by SN2; the methyl carbon is explicitly supplied by MeI and iodide/carbonate salts are non-product material. Strict site fidelity shows only Ar-O -> Ar-OCH3, with the naphthalene ring, all C-C connectivity, and stereochemistry preserved. This methyl ether is a deliberate reversible directing/protecting handle for the following electrophilic bromination and is removed by the already committed BBr3 event, so it adds route value rather than creating a redundant loop.

This reversible O-methyl handle is strategically useful for controlled electrophilic bromination and is removed later by the already committed BBr3 deprotection, so it is not an unproductive methylation loop.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Commit one Williamson etherification joining two complete PEG-bearing precursors. K2CO3 deprotonates tert-butyl 3-hydroxypropionate; its O attacks the primary C-Br of OCCOCCBr by SN2. The protected acid fragment supplies the t-butyl ester and first CH2CH2O segment, while the bromoethoxyethanol supplies the second ether and terminal CH2OH. The only new route-bearing bond is the desired primary C-O bond; Br leaves as KBr/carbonate salt, and no ring, stereochemical, or ester topology change occurs. Mild carbonate/primary-bromide conditions and stoichiometric dilution address elimination and donor self-reaction risks. The unmodeled salt/atom-balance warning is therefore a byproduct representation limit, not a missing scaffold source. This closes the PEG mini-route before its separately committed PBr3, TFA, and SOCl2 events.

llm_decision.selection_reasoning: Br2 supplies the only added bromine in one electrophilic aromatic substitution; HBr is the unmodeled byproduct. Strict mapping shows only one aromatic C-Br installation, with the phenolic oxygen, naphthalene topology, and all other sites preserved. The regioisomer distribution among activated naphthol positions remains an explicit experimental analytical risk because the validator has no regioselectivity model.

declared_intent.rationale_summary: Positive chemical case: Br2 performs one electrophilic aromatic substitution on the naphthol core to furnish the product-mapped aryl bromide, with HBr as the small-molecule byproduct. The phenolic oxygen and all naphthalene C-C bonds remain unchanged, and no ring or stereochemical event occurs. The product-mapped C-Br site is retained as the intended handle for the later Miyaura borylation. Because the internal validator has no experimental regioselectivity model, discrimination among activated naphthol positions is explicitly an analytical risk rather than a claimed fact.

route_plan_brief.route_thesis: 采用混合策略：保留已成型的醛基羟基萘-喹啉发色团与硼酸萘酰亚胺受体核心，先以可保护/可偶联的芳基卤化物和硼酸酯完成关键芳基连接，再晚期构建吡啶甲氧基-PEG-胺链与酯键；醛基和游离硼酸尽量在兼容性允许时后装。
key_disconnections: 末端羧酸/醇酯键：将吡啶甲氧基醇与3-(2-(2-(2-aminoethyl)ethoxy)ethoxy)丙酸或等效受保护酸片段分开。
酰亚胺氮-PEG-链连接：用受保护氨基乙基多醚卤化物对硼酸萘酰亚胺氮进行一次SN2/N-烷基化事件。
醛基羟基萘与喹啉核心的芳基-芳基键：用卤代喹啉与硼酸/金属化萘片段进行Suzuki或等效偶联，保留取代位点。
硼酸取代的萘酰亚胺受体核心：优先由可定位卤代萘酐/萘二羧酸前体经酰亚胺化与晚期硼化构建。
preferred_precursor_logic: 优先使用可独立表征的卤代喹啉、羟基甲酰基萘硼酸酯、受保护PEG卤化物和萘酰亚胺硼酸酯。
每个芳基新键只由一个明确的C-B/C-X或C-M前体提供，避免虚构碳源。
末端胺以Boc或邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护，待酯化及金属步骤完成后脱保护。
protect_or_preserve: 保留醛基羟基萘和喹啉稠合拓扑，除非位点证据迫使骨架组装。
硼酸以Bpin或其他可耐受偶联的形式暂时保护；末端胺以Boc/邻苯二甲酰亚胺保护。
在强碱/金属偶联前保护游离酚和醛基，避免副反应；把脱保护作为独立树步骤。
mode_evidence: 目标含7个芳香环、两个稠合内酰亚胺/酰亚胺单元和硼酸，直接从头组装全部骨架会放大拓扑与选择性风险。
目标中醛基、酯键、苄基醚和末端胺链是明确的晚期官能团化把手，适合与成熟多环片段汇合。
芳基-芳基连接与受体片段接入应作为单独真实事件验证，不能压缩为一步。
strategic_risks: 喹啉/吡啶多氮芳杂环的区域选择性和碱敏感性可能限制交叉偶联与醚化顺序。
硼酸、醛基和游离胺在氧化、强碱和金属条件下存在保护/兼容性问题。
末端多醚链的SN2或酯化可能与芳杂环氮发生副反应，需明确保护与原子来源。
revision_triggers: 位点地图显示关键芳基连接无法由晚期偶联保持拓扑时，转向非最终电子态或骨架组装。
验证发现硼酸/醛基在计划偶联条件下不可兼容时，改为硼酸酯晚装或醛基后氧化/甲酰化。
若PEG-胺链只能通过不可靠的非选择性烷基化接入，则先重订保护-脱保护和酯化顺序。
